Documented here so the omission is\n    // intentional rather than an oversight in the V8\u2192V10 consolidation.\n    // ========================================================================\n\n    /// @notice Initiate an operator-fee withdrawal. Caller must hold ADMIN_KEY\n    ///         on `identityId`. Subsequent calls before finalize/cancel\n    ///         augment the existing request (combined amount = old + new).\n    function requestOperatorFeeWithdrawal(uint72 identityId, uint96 withdrawalAmount) external onlyAdmin(identityId) {\n        if (withdrawalAmount == 0) revert TokenLib.ZeroTokenAmount();\n\n        ConvictionStakingStorage cs = convictionStorage;\n\n        uint96 existingRequestAmount = cs.getOperatorFeeWithdrawalRequestAmount(identityId);\n        uint96 currentOperatorFeeBalance = cs.getOperatorFeeBalance(identityId);\n\n        // If a request already exists, the requested funds were already\n        // moved out of the balance into the queue \u2014 restore them before we\n        // re-check the cap so the totalRequestAmount comparison is honest.\n        if (existingRequestAmount > 0) {\n            currentOperatorFeeBalance += existingRequestAmount;\n        }\n\n        uint96 totalRequestAmount = existingRequestAmount + withdrawalAmount;\n        if (totalRequestAmount > currentOperatorFeeBalance) {\n            revert StakingLib.AmountExceedsOperatorFeeBalance(currentOperatorFeeBalance, totalRequestAmount);\n        }\n\n        uint256 withdrawalReleaseTimestamp = block.timestamp + parametersStorage.stakeWithdrawalDelay();\n        cs.setOperatorFeeBalance(identityId, currentOperatorFeeBalance - totalRequestAmount);\n        cs.createOperatorFeeWithdrawalRequest(identityId, totalRequestAmount, /*indexed*/ 0, withdrawalReleaseTimestamp);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Complete an operator-fee withdrawal after the cooldown has\n    ///         elapsed. Pays out from the CSS TRAC vault.\n    function finalizeOperatorFeeWithdrawal(uint72 identityId) external onlyAdmin(identityId) {\n        ConvictionStakingStorage cs = convictionStorage;\n\n        (uint96 operatorFeeWithdrawalAmount, , uint256 withdrawalReleaseTimestamp) = cs.getOperatorFeeWithdrawalRequest(\n            identityId\n        );\n        if (operatorFeeWithdrawalAmount == 0) revert StakingLib.WithdrawalWasntInitiated();\n        if (block.timestamp < withdrawalReleaseTimestamp) {\n            revert StakingLib.WithdrawalPeriodPending(block.timestamp, withdrawalReleaseTimestamp);\n        }\n\n        cs.deleteOperatorFeeWithdrawalRequest(identityId);\n        cs.transferStake(msg.sender, operatorFeeWithdrawalAmount);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Cancel a pending operator-fee withdrawal and return the queued\n    ///         amount to the operator-fee balance. No cooldown applies.\n    function cancelOperatorFeeWithdrawal(uint72 identityId) external onlyAdmin(identityId) {\n        ConvictionStakingStorage cs = convictionStorage;\n\n        uint96 operatorFeeWithdrawalAmount = cs.getOperatorFeeWithdrawalRequestAmount(identityId);\n        if (operatorFeeWithdrawalAmount == 0) revert StakingLib.WithdrawalWasntInitiated();\n\n        cs.deleteOperatorFeeWithdrawalRequest(identityId);\n        cs.increaseOperatorFeeBalance(identityId, operatorFeeWithdrawalAmount);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice Walk unclaimed epochs, accumulate reward, and compound it into\n     *         the position's `raw` (D19). `cumulativeRewardsClaimed` tracks\n     *         lifetime compounding as a statistic.\n     *\n     * @dev D6 \u2014 retroactive claim for migrated positions. If\n     *      `pos.migrationEpoch != 0` AND `pos.migrationEpoch > pos.lastClaimedEpoch + 1`,\n     *      the claim window starts from `pos.migrationEpoch` instead of\n     *      `pos.lastClaimedEpoch + 1`. For a fresh V8\u2192V10 migration where\n     *      the user never claimed pre-migration, this collapses to \"start\n     *      the claim at the migration epoch\". For a later-life migration\n     *      (shouldn't happen in the mandatory-migration model but kept\n     *      behavior-defined), the `max(lastClaimedEpoch+1, migrationEpoch)`\n     *      semantics prevent double-claiming.\n     *\n     *      D19 \u2014 reward handling:\n     *        1. Sum per-epoch rewards across the window (V10 math \u2014\n     *           CSS per-epoch operator fee + net-node rewards).\n     *        2. `cs.increaseRaw(tokenId, rewardTotal)` \u2014 raw grows; the\n     *           compounded TRAC earns the position's current multiplier\n     *           going forward; per-epoch effective-stake diff updated.\n     *        3. `cs.addCumulativeRewardsClaimed(tokenId, rewardTotal)` \u2014\n     *           statistic-only lifetime counter.\n     *        4. `cs.setLastClaimedEpoch(tokenId, toEpoch)` \u2014 advance cursor.\n     *      No StakingStorage writes.\n     */\n    // The first arg (the staker address) is intentionally UNNAMED: it is\n    // retained only for ABI compatibility with the DEPLOYED DKGStakingConvictionNFT\n    // wrapper (10.0.3), whose owner-gated `claim` calls\n    // `stakingV10.claim(msg.sender, tokenId)`. Keeping this 2-arg signature means\n    // the existing wrapper keeps working after StakingV10 is redeployed \u2014 so no\n    // wrapper redeploy (which would orphan position NFTs) is needed. Settlement is\n    // tokenId-keyed (the NFT owner is the beneficiary), so the address is unused.\n    function claim(address, uint256 tokenId) external onlyConvictionNFT {\n        _claim(tokenId);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Permissionless settlement: ANY caller may trigger a claim for\n    ///         `tokenId`. Rewards compound into the tokenId-keyed position, so\n    ///         the current NFT owner benefits regardless of caller \u2014 no funds\n    ///         are routed to `msg.sender`. This is the wrapper-independent\n    ///         permissionless-claim entry point: keepers can settle rewards (and\n    ///         the per-epoch operator fee) without touching the stateful ERC-721\n    ///         wrapper. `_claim` reverts `PositionNotFound` for a nonexistent or\n    ///         already-withdrawn position, so no extra guard is required.\n    function claimFor(uint256 tokenId) external {\n        _claim(tokenId);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @dev Internal claim body shared between the external `claim` entry\n     *      point and the atomic `withdraw` path. Advances the position's\n     *      reward cursor and compounds any outstanding rewards into `raw`.\n     *      No-op when the position has no unclaimed window (early epochs\n     *      or `lastClaimedEpoch == currentEpoch - 1`).\n     */\n    /// @dev Best-effort sharding-table admission. Callers gate on eligibility\n    /// (node not in table AND stake >= minimumStake) before calling. A full\n    /// table (`ShardingTableIsFull`) MUST NOT revert the caller's\n    /// stake/claim/withdraw/redelegate \u2014 admission is opportunistic housekeeping.\n    /// On failure the node stays out of the ring (earning no score, which is the\n    /// correct incentive) and is re-attempted by the next stake/claim once a slot\n    /// frees. Fixes #1286 (a full table previously blocked claim \u2014 and via\n    /// `withdraw`'s auto-claim, raw-stake withdrawal too).\n    ///\n    /// NB: a node deferred while OUT of the ring earns no reward, so a later\n    /// zero-reward `_claim` returns before its inline admission and will NOT\n    /// re-admit it. `admitNode` below is the permissionless recovery for that.\n    function _tryAdmitNode(uint72 identityId) internal {\n        try shardingTable.insertNode(identityId) {\n            // admitted\n        } catch (bytes memory reason) {\n            // Only a full table (ShardingTableIsFull) is an expected, benign\n            // deferral. Any other revert (a Hub-wiring / index-invariant / future\n            // check failure) is a real error we must NOT mask while the caller's\n            // staking state is already mutated \u2014 rethrow the original revert.\n            bytes4 selector;\n            if (reason.length >= 4) {\n                // solhint-disable-next-line no-inline-assembly\n                assembly {\n                    selector := mload(add(reason, 0x20))\n                }\n            }\n            if (selector == ShardingTable.ShardingTableIsFull.selector) {\n                // ShardingTable rolled back its own state on the full-table revert;\n                // it is a trusted Hub-registered contract, so emitting after the\n                // call is safe (slither reentrancy-events false positive).\n                // slither-disable-next-line reentrancy-events\n                emit NodeAdmissionDeferred(identityId, convictionStorage.getNodeStakeV10(identityId));\n            } else {\n                // solhint-disable-next-line no-inline-assembly\n                assembly {\n                    revert(add(reason, 0x20), mload(reason))\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Permissionless maintenance: admit a node that is eligible for the\n    /// sharding table (V10 stake >= `minimumStake`) but not currently in it \u2014\n    /// e.g. one whose opportunistic admission was deferred because the table was\n    /// full (`_tryAdmitNode` / #1286). Anyone may bring an eligible node into the\n    /// ring once a slot frees, without the node's staker needing to add stake or\n    /// trigger a reward claim (a zero-reward `_claim` returns before its inline\n    /// admission). Reverts `ShardingTableIsFull` if the table is still full (so\n    /// the caller learns), or `NodeAlreadyInShardingTable` / `NodeBelowMinimumStake`\n    /// if the node is not eligible.\n    function admitNode(uint72 identityId) external {\n        if (shardingTableStorage.nodeExists(identityId)) {\n            revert NodeAlreadyInShardingTable(identityId);\n        }\n        if (convictionStorage.getNodeStakeV10(identityId) < uint256(parametersStorage.minimumStake())) {\n            revert NodeBelowMinimumStake(identityId);\n        }\n        shardingTable.insertNode(identityId);\n        ask.recalculateActiveSet();\n    }\n\n    function _claim(uint256 tokenId) internal {\n        ConvictionStakingStorage.Position memory pos = convictionStorage.getPosition(tokenId);\n        if (pos.identityId == 0) revert PositionNotFound();\n\n        uint256 currentEpoch = chronos.getCurrentEpoch();\n        if (currentEpoch <= 1) return;\n\n        // D6 \u2014 retroactive claim on migrationEpoch.\n        uint256 lastClaimed = uint256(pos.lastClaimedEpoch);\n        uint256 migrationEpoch = uint256(pos.migrationEpoch);\n        uint256 claimFromEpoch = lastClaimed + 1;\n        if (migrationEpoch != 0 && migrationEpoch > claimFromEpoch) {\n            claimFromEpoch = migrationEpoch;\n        }\n        uint256 claimToEpoch = currentEpoch - 1;\n        if (claimFromEpoch > claimToEpoch) return;\n\n        _prepareForStakeChangeV10(currentEpoch, tokenId, pos.identityId);\n\n        // Local cache.\n        uint256 rawU = uint256(pos.raw);\n        uint256 mult18 = uint256(pos.multiplier18);\n        uint256 expiryTs = uint256(pos.expiryTimestamp);\n        // D26 \u2014 wall-clock \u2192 epoch projection of the position's expiry.\n        // 0 for tier-0 (no boost, no expiry).\n        uint256 expiryEpoch = expiryTs == 0 ? 0 : chronos.epochAtTimestamp(expiryTs);\n        uint72 identityId = pos.identityId;\n        bytes32 delegatorKey = bytes32(tokenId);\n\n        uint256 effBoosted = (rawU * mult18) / SCALE18;\n        uint256 effBase = rawU;\n\n        uint256 rewardTotal = 0;\n        for (uint256 e = claimFromEpoch; e <= claimToEpoch; e++) {\n            // H1 \u2014 fast path for rewardless epochs. `getEpochLastScorePerStake`\n            // is 0 iff no proof was ever submitted on this node in epoch `e`.\n            // When that is the case: no node score, no delegator score, no\n            // operator-fee math, nothing to settle. Skipping here collapses a\n            // dormant-epoch iteration from ~25k gas (4 SLOADs + 1 SSTORE for\n            // the fee flag) to ~2k gas (single SLOAD + continue). This is\n            // what keeps long-dormant tier-0 positions claimable.\n            uint256 scorePerStake36 = randomSamplingStorage.getEpochLastScorePerStake(identityId, e);\n            if (scorePerStake36 == 0) continue;\n\n            uint256 settledDelegatorScore18 = randomSamplingStorage.getEpochNodeDelegatorScore(\n                e,\n                identityId,\n                delegatorKey\n            );\n            uint256 lastSettledIndex36 = randomSamplingStorage\n                .getDelegatorLastSettledNodeEpochScorePerStake(e, identityId, delegatorKey);\n\n            // H2 \u2014 expiry-split reward integration shared with\n            //      `_prepareForStakeChangeV10`.\n            uint256 unsettledDelegatorScore18 = _delegatorIncrementForEpoch(\n                e,\n                identityId,\n                scorePerStake36,\n                lastSettledIndex36,\n                effBoosted,\n                effBase,\n                expiryTs,\n                expiryEpoch\n            );\n            uint256 delegatorScore18 = settledDelegatorScore18 + unsettledDelegatorScore18;\n\n            rewardTotal += _nodeEpochReward(e, identityId, delegatorScore18);\n        }\n\n        // v10.0.3 \u2014 integrate matured reward carries (pointers to RSS score\n        // slots recorded by mid-epoch `redelegate`/`relock`; see CSS struct\n        // docs). A carry matures once its epoch is <= `claimToEpoch`.\n        {\n            ConvictionStakingStorage.RewardCarry[] memory carries =\n                convictionStorage.getRewardCarries(tokenId);\n            bool carriesMatured = false;\n            for (uint256 i = 0; i < carries.length; i++) {\n                if (uint256(carries[i].epoch) > claimToEpoch) continue;\n                carriesMatured = true;\n                // The main loop above already integrated the position's\n                // CURRENT (node, key) slot for every epoch in the window \u2014\n                // skip a carry that points at it (e.g. A\u2192B\u2192A round-trip).\n                if (carries[i].identityId == identityId && carries[i].delegatorKey == delegatorKey) {\n                    continue;\n                }\n                uint256 carryScore18 = randomSamplingStorage.getEpochNodeDelegatorScore(\n                    uint256(carries[i].epoch),\n                    carries[i].identityId,\n                    carries[i].delegatorKey\n                );\n                if (carryScore18 == 0) continue;\n                rewardTotal += _nodeEpochReward(\n                    uint256(carries[i].epoch),\n                    carries[i].identityId,\n                    carryScore18\n                );\n            }\n            if (carriesMatured) {\n                convictionStorage.clearRewardCarries(tokenId, uint32(claimToEpoch));\n            }\n        }\n\n        if (rewardTotal == 0) {\n            // No-reward window: just advance the claim cursor.\n            convictionStorage.setLastClaimedEpoch(tokenId, uint32(claimToEpoch));\n            return;\n        }\n\n        if (rewardTotal > type(uint96).max) revert RewardOverflow();\n        uint96 rewardU96 = uint96(rewardTotal);\n\n        // D19 \u2014 compound into raw. CSS writes the per-epoch effective-stake\n        // diff and bumps nodeStakeV10 / totalStakeV10 in lockstep. The\n        // compounded TRAC earns the position's current multiplier.\n        convictionStorage.increaseRaw(tokenId, rewardU96);\n        convictionStorage.addCumulativeRewardsClaimed(tokenId, rewardU96);\n\n        // Sharding-table + Ask housekeeping \u2014 the reward compound grew\n        // node stake; a node previously under `minimumStake` may now be\n        // eligible for the sharding table. Reward is always an increase,\n        // so only the cross-above-minimum insert is needed.\n        {\n            uint256 newNodeStake = convictionStorage.getNodeStakeV10(identityId);\n            if (\n                !shardingTableStorage.nodeExists(identityId) &&\n                newNodeStake >= uint256(parametersStorage.minimumStake())\n            ) {\n                _tryAdmitNode(identityId);\n            }\n        }\n        ask.recalculateActiveSet();\n\n        convictionStorage.setLastClaimedEpoch(tokenId, uint32(claimToEpoch));\n\n        emit RewardsClaimed(tokenId, rewardU96);\n    }\n\n    // ========================================================================\n    // V8\u2192V10 \"pool & allocate\" migration workers\n    // ========================================================================\n    //\n    // The NFT wrapper (DKGStakingConvictionNFT) is the only caller\n    // (onlyConvictionNFT). It owns the tokenId counter + ERC-721 mint and the\n    // owner gating; these workers do the privileged StakingStorage/CSS\n    // mutations. `drainV8ToCredit` is the drain half of the old `_convertToNFT`\n    // (now per-node, mints nothing, credits CSS); `allocateFromCredit` is the\n    // V10-seed half (now funded from migration credit, not a fresh transfer).\n\n    /// @notice Drain ALL of `delegator`'s V8 stake on `identityId` (active\n    ///         stakeBase + any pending withdrawal, D8) into their migration\n    ///         credit on CSS. Returns the drained `total` so the wrapper can\n    ///         aggregate across nodes and revert if the grand total is zero;\n    ///         a node with no V8 stake contributes 0 (no revert here).\n    /// @dev    no per-source eligibility: the full drained amount is\n    ///         credited to the delegator; the tier-6/12 lock-credit is decided\n    ///         later in `allocateFromCredit` from the chosen tier.\n    function drainV8ToCredit(\n        address delegator,\n        uint72 identityId\n    ) external onlyConvictionNFT returns (uint96 total) {\n        // Freeze-first invariant (on-chain): the V8 `Staking` logic must be\n        // unregistered before ANY drain (admin sweep OR self-migrate). A drain\n        // zeroes stakeBase without settling the reward cursor; if V8 `Staking`\n        // is still live it keeps computing rewards/sharding off StakingStorage,\n        // so draining against live state corrupts it. Gating here covers every\n        // drain path through one chokepoint; selfMigrate auto-opens at freeze.\n        if (hub.isContract(\"Staking\")) revert V8StakingStillLive();\n        bytes32 v8Key = keccak256(abi.encodePacked(delegator));\n        StakingStorage ss = stakingStorage;\n        uint96 stakeBase = ss.getDelegatorStakeBase(identityId, v8Key);\n        uint96 pending = ss.getDelegatorWithdrawalRequestAmount(identityId, v8Key);\n        total = stakeBase + pending;\n        if (total == 0) return 0;\n\n        // V8 drain. Pending was already excluded from node/total stake at\n        // request time, so only the active base is decremented.\n        if (stakeBase > 0) {\n            ss.setDelegatorStakeBase(identityId, v8Key, 0);\n            ss.decreaseNodeStake(identityId, stakeBase);\n            ss.decreaseTotalStake(stakeBase);\n        }\n        if (pending > 0) {\n            ss.deleteDelegatorWithdrawalRequest(identityId, v8Key);\n        }\n        // Move the migrated TRAC SS -> CSS so the credit stays collateralized.\n        ss.transferStake(address(convictionStorage), total);\n\n        convictionStorage.addMigrationCredit(delegator, total);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Drain node `identityId`'s V8 operator fee (the resting\n    ///         `operatorFeeBalance` PLUS any open fee-withdrawal request) into\n    ///         `operator`'s migration credit on CSS. Returns the drained\n    ///         `total`; a node with no fee contributes 0 (no revert here), so\n    ///         the wrapper can sweep in bulk.\n    /// @dev    \"one credit\": the operator fee folds\n    ///         into the SAME `migrationCredit` bucket as delegator stake, so\n    ///         the operator recovers it exactly like a delegator \u2014 `allocate`\n    ///         at tier 0 (immediately withdrawable) or 6/12 (conviction).\n    ///\n    ///         Operator addresses are NOT recoverable on-chain \u2014 IdentityStorage\n    ///         holds key *hashes*, not addresses \u2014 so the off-chain sweep\n    ///         supplies `operator` and this function validates it currently\n    ///         holds ADMIN_KEY on the node (mirroring who V8\n    ///         `finalizeOperatorFeeWithdrawal` would have paid). A stale/wrong\n    ///         address REVERTS rather than crediting silently, so a\n    ///         mis-resolved operator can never be paid; the sweep hard-fails\n    ///         and re-resolves. The check is skipped only when there is nothing\n    ///         to drain (`total == 0`), keeping re-runs idempotent and cheap.\n    function drainOperatorFeeToCredit(\n        uint72 identityId,\n        address operator\n    ) external onlyConvictionNFT returns (uint96 total) {\n        // Freeze-first invariant (see drainV8ToCredit) \u2014 no fee drain while V8\n        // Staking is still live and could finalize/restake the same balance.\n        if (hub.isContract(\"Staking\")) revert V8StakingStillLive();\n        StakingStorage ss = stakingStorage;\n        uint96 feeBalance = ss.getOperatorFeeBalance(identityId);\n        uint96 feeRequest = ss.getOperatorFeeWithdrawalRequestAmount(identityId);\n        total = feeBalance + feeRequest;\n        if (total == 0) return 0;\n\n        // Credit only an address that currently controls the node.\n        if (\n            !identityStorage.keyHasPurpose(\n                identityId,\n                keccak256(abi.encodePacked(operator)),\n                IdentityLib.ADMIN_KEY\n            )\n        ) {\n            revert Permissions.OnlyProfileAdminFunction(operator);\n        }\n\n        // Zero the V8 fee slots (idempotent: a re-drain reads 0, returns 0).\n        // The open-request amount stayed in the SS vault at request time (no\n        // token moved), so deleting it here releases it for the SS->CSS move.\n        if (feeBalance > 0) {\n            ss.setOperatorFeeBalance(identityId, 0);\n        }\n        if (feeRequest > 0) {\n            ss.deleteOperatorFeeWithdrawalRequest(identityId);\n        }\n        // Move the migrated TRAC SS -> CSS so the credit stays collateralized.\n        ss.transferStake(address(convictionStorage), total);\n\n        convictionStorage.addMigrationCredit(operator, total);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Spend `amount` of `staker`'s migration credit into a fresh V10\n    ///         conviction position on `targetNode` at `lockTier`. Runs the full\n    ///         stake tail (score-cursor baseline \u2192 createPosition \u2192 sharding\n    ///         insert \u2192 ask recalc). Any tier-6/12 allocation applies the\n    ///         `convictionCreditSeconds` lock-shortening (universal). The\n    ///         wrapper supplies `tokenId` and mints after.\n    function allocateFromCredit(\n        address staker,\n        uint256 tokenId,\n        uint72 targetNode,\n        uint96 amount,\n        uint40 lockTier\n    ) external onlyConvictionNFT returns (bool creditApplied) {\n        if (!profileStorage.profileExists(targetNode)) revert ProfileDoesNotExist();\n        ConvictionStakingStorage cs = convictionStorage;\n        // Active-tier check: createPosition skips _requireActiveTier on the\n        // migration path (migrationEpoch > 0), and this is a NEW tier choice\n        // (not honoring a prior V8 commitment), so reject deactivated tiers \u2014\n        // EXCEPT tier 0. Tier 0 is the no-lock recovery sink that guarantees\n        // admin-drained credit is always withdrawable in two txs (allocate\n        // tier-0 -> withdraw); exempting it keeps that safety net independent of\n        // whether the owner has retired the no-lock product.\n        require(lockTier == 0 || cs.getTier(lockTier).active, \"Inactive tier\");\n\n        // maxStake cap on the destination node (post-allocation aggregate).\n        if (cs.getNodeStakeV10(targetNode) + uint256(amount) > uint256(parametersStorage.maximumStake())) {\n            revert MaxStakeExceeded();\n        }\n\n        // Debit credit (reverts if amount == 0 or > migrationCredit). The\n        // tier-6/12 conviction lock-credit is universal \u2014 any 6/12\n        // migration allocation earns it (no per-staker eligibility).\n        cs.spendMigrationCredit(staker, amount);\n        // `creditApplied` must reflect shortening that was ACTUALLY applied:\n        // a tier-6/12 allocation while `convictionCreditSeconds == 0` (credit\n        // not yet configured) shortens by 0, so the flag/event would otherwise\n        // claim a credit that wasn't granted. Gate it on a non-zero duration.\n        uint40 creditSeconds = cs.convictionCreditSeconds();\n        creditApplied = (lockTier == 6 || lockTier == 12) && creditSeconds > 0;\n        uint40 expiryShortenedBy = creditApplied ? creditSeconds : 0;\n\n        uint256 currentEpoch = chronos.getCurrentEpoch();\n        // Baseline the V10 score cursor BEFORE createPosition so the creation\n        // epoch is not retroactively over-credited.\n        _prepareForStakeChangeV10(currentEpoch, tokenId, targetNode);\n\n        cs.createPosition(tokenId, targetNode, amount, lockTier, uint32(currentEpoch), expiryShortenedBy);\n\n        if (\n            !shardingTableStorage.nodeExists(targetNode) &&\n            cs.getNodeStakeV10(targetNode) >= uint256(parametersStorage.minimumStake())\n        ) {\n            _tryAdmitNode(targetNode);\n        }\n        ask.recalculateActiveSet();\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Set the V8\u2192V10 conviction lock-credit (seconds) on CSS. Driven\n    ///         by the owner-gated `setConvictionCreditSeconds` entrypoint on the\n    ///         NFT wrapper (no freeze gate; settable any time pre-sweep).\n    function setConvictionCreditSeconds(uint40 secondsValue) external onlyConvictionNFT {\n        convictionStorage.setConvictionCreditSeconds(secondsValue);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @notice Admin: set the V10 launch epoch marker on CSS. This is the\n     *         retroactive-attribution boundary used by the admin migration\n     *         bookkeeping and off-chain analytics. Expected to be called\n     *         exactly once, in the deploy-script migration cutover. Gate\n     *         enforced at the NFT wrapper (`onlyOwnerOrMultiSigOwner`).\n     *\n     * @dev D7 \u2014 the V10 launch epoch is the cutoff past which V8-era\n     *      state should not continue to accrue rewards; anything the\n     *      migration process hasn't swept by this epoch is treated as a\n     *      straggler and drained via `adminDrainBatch` / `adminMigrateToCredit`.\n     */\n    function setV10LaunchEpoch(uint256 epoch) external onlyConvictionNFT {\n        convictionStorage.setV10LaunchEpoch(epoch);\n    }\n\n\n    // ========================================================================\n    // Internal helpers \u2014 V10 score-per-stake settlement\n    // ========================================================================\n\n    /**\n     * @dev Convert a delegator's epoch score on `identityId` into TRAC,\n     *      lazily materializing the node's operator-fee split for `(e,\n     *      identityId)` on first touch. Extracted from the `_claim` epoch\n     *      loop (v10.0.3) so reward carries share the exact same math.\n     *\n     *      H1 note \u2014 on epochs with `scorePerStake36 > 0 && nodeScore18 ==\n     *      0` this returns 0. That combination is essentially impossible in\n     *      production (score-per-stake can only be advanced by submitProof,\n     *      which also adds to node score), but defensive: there is no fee\n     *      to collect and no reward.\n     */\n    function _nodeEpochReward(\n        uint256 e,\n        uint72 identityId,\n        uint256 delegatorScore18\n    ) internal returns (uint256 epochReward) {\n        uint256 nodeScore18 = randomSamplingStorage.getNodeEpochScore(e, identityId);\n        if (nodeScore18 == 0) return 0;\n\n        uint256 netNodeRewards;\n        if (!convictionStorage.isOperatorFeeClaimedForEpoch(identityId, e)) {\n            uint256 allNodesScore18 = randomSamplingStorage.getAllNodesEpochScore(e);\n            if (allNodesScore18 > 0) {\n                uint256 grossNodeRewards = (epochStorage.getEpochPool(EPOCH_POOL_INDEX, e)\n                    * nodeScore18) / allNodesScore18;\n                uint96 operatorFeeAmount = uint96(\n                    (grossNodeRewards\n                        * profileStorage.getOperatorFeePercentageByTimestampReverse(identityId, chronos.timestampForEpoch(e + 1) - 1))\n                        / parametersStorage.maxOperatorFee()\n                );\n                netNodeRewards = grossNodeRewards - operatorFeeAmount;\n                convictionStorage.setIsOperatorFeeClaimedForEpoch(identityId, e, true);\n                convictionStorage.setNetNodeEpochRewards(identityId, e, netNodeRewards);\n                // v4.0.0 \u2014 operator-fee balance lives on CSS now.\n                convictionStorage.increaseOperatorFeeBalance(identityId, operatorFeeAmount);\n            }\n        } else {\n            netNodeRewards = convictionStorage.getNetNodeEpochRewards(identityId, e);\n        }\n\n        if (delegatorScore18 > 0) {\n            epochReward = (delegatorScore18 * netNodeRewards) / nodeScore18;\n        }\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @dev D26 \u2014 settle the delegator's score accumulator for `epoch` up to\n     *      the latest on-chain proof. If the position lives on `identityId`,\n     *      integrate using its current effective stake, splitting at\n     *      `expiryTimestamp` when the boost transition lands inside `epoch`.\n     *      Otherwise (redelegate to a different node, or migration baseline)\n     *      just bump the delegator's cursor to the current last-value.\n     */\n    function _prepareForStakeChangeV10(\n        uint256 epoch,\n        uint256 tokenId,\n        uint72 identityId\n    ) internal returns (uint256 delegatorScore) {\n        bytes32 delegatorKey = bytes32(tokenId);\n        ConvictionStakingStorage.Position memory pos = convictionStorage.getPosition(tokenId);\n\n        uint256 nodeScorePerStake36 = randomSamplingStorage.getEpochLastScorePerStake(identityId, epoch);\n        uint256 currentDelegatorScore18 = randomSamplingStorage.getEpochNodeDelegatorScore(\n            epoch,\n            identityId,\n            delegatorKey\n        );\n        uint256 lastSettled = randomSamplingStorage.getDelegatorLastSettledNodeEpochScorePerStake(\n            epoch,\n            identityId,\n            delegatorKey\n        );\n\n        if (nodeScorePerStake36 == lastSettled) {\n            return currentDelegatorScore18;\n        }\n\n        uint256 scoreEarned18 = 0;\n        if (pos.identityId == identityId) {\n            uint256 rawU = uint256(pos.raw);\n            uint256 mult18 = uint256(pos.multiplier18);\n            uint256 expiryTs = uint256(pos.expiryTimestamp);\n            uint256 expiryEpoch = expiryTs == 0 ? 0 : chronos.epochAtTimestamp(expiryTs);\n            uint256 effBoosted = (rawU * mult18) / SCALE18;\n            uint256 effBase = rawU;\n\n            scoreEarned18 = _delegatorIncrementForEpoch(\n                epoch,\n                identityId,\n                nodeScorePerStake36,\n                lastSettled,\n                effBoosted,\n                effBase,\n                expiryTs,\n                expiryEpoch\n            );\n        }\n\n        if (scoreEarned18 > 0) {\n            randomSamplingStorage.addToEpochNodeDelegatorScore(epoch, identityId, delegatorKey, scoreEarned18);\n        }\n        randomSamplingStorage.setDelegatorLastSettledNodeEpochScorePerStake(\n            epoch,\n            identityId,\n            delegatorKey,\n            nodeScorePerStake36\n        );\n\n        return currentDelegatorScore18 + scoreEarned18;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @dev H2 \u2014 shared D26 expiry-split reward integration. Returns the\n     *      delegator's earned score increment (18-decimals) across the\n     *      settlement window `(lastSettled, current]` in epoch `epoch`,\n     *      honoring the position's boost transition at `expiryTs`.\n     *\n     * Cases, in order:\n     *   * `current <= lastSettled`       \u2192 nothing to integrate.\n     *   * `expiryTs == 0`                \u2192 tier-0 rest state; no boost\n     *                                      transition ever. Use `effBase`.\n     *   * `epoch < expiryEpoch`          \u2192 boost fully active in epoch.\n     *                                      Use `effBoosted`.\n     *   * `epoch > expiryEpoch`          \u2192 boost already dropped for the\n     *                                      whole epoch. Use `effBase`.\n     *   * `epoch == expiryEpoch` with\n     *     `effBoosted == effBase`        \u2192 M4: boost delta is zero (1x\n     *                                      \"locked\" tier). Skip the\n     *                                      binary search, integrate with\n     *                                      `effBase`.\n     *   * `epoch == expiryEpoch` with\n     *     `effBoosted > effBase`         \u2192 one binary search into the\n     *                                      epoch's checkpoint array gives\n     *                                      scorePerStake strictly before the\n     *                                      expiry second; integrate the\n     *                                      left half at boosted rate and\n     *                                      the right half at base rate.\n     *                                      `scoreBeforeExpiry` below the\n     *                                      delegator cursor collapses\n     *                                      back to the base-rate path.\n     */\n    function _delegatorIncrementForEpoch(\n        uint256 epoch,\n        uint72 identityId,\n        uint256 current,\n        uint256 lastSettled,\n        uint256 effBoosted,\n        uint256 effBase,\n        uint256 expiryTs,\n        uint256 expiryEpoch\n    ) internal view returns (uint256) {\n        if (current <= lastSettled) return 0;\n\n        if (expiryTs == 0 || epoch < expiryEpoch) {\n            uint256 eff = expiryTs == 0 ? effBase : effBoosted;\n            return (eff * (current - lastSettled)) / SCALE18;\n        }\n        if (epoch > expiryEpoch) {\n            return (effBase * (current - lastSettled)) / SCALE18;\n        }\n        // epoch == expiryEpoch.\n        if (effBoosted == effBase) {\n            // M4 \u2014 degenerate tier (duration>0, mult==1x). No boost delta at\n            //      expiry, so no split is needed and we skip the binary\n            //      search.\n            return (effBase * (current - lastSettled)) / SCALE18;\n        }\n        uint256 scoreBeforeExpiry = randomSamplingStorage.findScorePerStakeAt(\n            identityId,\n            epoch,\n            uint40(expiryTs - 1)\n        );\n        if (scoreBeforeExpiry > lastSettled) {\n            return\n                (effBoosted * (scoreBeforeExpiry - lastSettled)) / SCALE18 +\n                (effBase * (current - scoreBeforeExpiry)) / SCALE18;\n        }\n        return (effBase * (current - lastSettled)) / SCALE18;\n    }\n}\n","keccak256":"0xfe7d21e9f71ff488ed512bada501b06239d6e28f77899671c009a6952e3a8313","license":"Apache-2.0"},"contracts/abstract/ContractStatus.sol":{"content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0\n\npragma solidity ^0.8.20;\n\nimport {HubDependent} from \"./HubDependent.sol\";\n\nabstract contract ContractStatus is HubDependent {\n    bool public status;\n\n    // solhint-disable-next-line no-empty-blocks\n    constructor(address hubAddress) HubDependent(hubAddress) {}\n\n    function setStatus(bool _status) external onlyHub {\n        status = _status;\n    }\n}\n","keccak256":"0x6eeb698feb6e409965b19a80bb5d7cd61488519ed156a80a354d76a65ae5d368","license":"Apache-2.0"},"contracts/abstract/HubDependent.sol":{"content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0\n\npragma solidity ^0.8.20;\n\nimport {Hub} from \"../storage/Hub.sol\";\nimport {HubLib} from \"../libraries/HubLib.sol\";\n\nabstract contract HubDependent {\n    Hub public hub;\n\n    constructor(address hubAddress) {\n        if (hubAddress == address(0)) {\n            revert HubLib.ZeroAddressHub();\n        }\n\n        hub = Hub(hubAddress);\n    }\n\n    modifier onlyHub() {\n        _checkHub();\n        _;\n    }\n\n    modifier onlyHubOwner() {\n        _checkHubOwner();\n        _;\n    }\n\n    modifier onlyContracts() {\n        _checkHubContract();\n        _;\n    }\n\n    function _checkHub() internal view virtual {\n        if (msg.sender != address(hub) && msg.sender != hub.owner()) {\n            revert HubLib.UnauthorizedAccess(\"Only Hub\");\n does (already trusted protocol-wide for epoch advancement).\n        // No randomness derivation, no PRNG semantics.\n        // slither-disable-next-line weak-prng\n        uint256 elapsed = (block.timestamp - START_TIME) % EPOCH_LENGTH;\n        return EPOCH_LENGTH - elapsed;\n    }\n\n    function hasEpochElapsed(uint256 epochNumber) external view returns (bool) {\n        return block.timestamp >= (START_TIME + (epochNumber - 1) * EPOCH_LENGTH);\n    }\n\n    function timestampForEpoch(uint256 epochNumber) external view returns (uint256) {\n        if (epochNumber == 0) {\n            return 0;\n        }\n        return START_TIME + (epochNumber - 1) * EPOCH_LENGTH;\n    }\n\n    function elapsedTimeInCurrentEpoch() external view returns (uint256) {\n        if (block.timestamp < START_TIME) {\n            return 0;\n        }\n        // Slither weak-prng \u2014 deterministic time math, not randomness.\n        // See `timeUntilNextEpoch` above for the long-form rationale.\n        // slither-disable-next-line weak-prng\n        return (block.timestamp - START_TIME) % EPOCH_LENGTH;\n    }\n\n    function totalElapsedTime() external view returns (uint256) {\n        if (block.timestamp < START_TIME) {\n            return 0;\n        }\n        return block.timestamp - START_TIME;\n    }\n\n    function isChronosActive() external view returns (bool) {\n        return block.timestamp >= START_TIME;\n    }\n}\n","keccak256":"0x1c1fa02e0ea347116b72bf3d9df60a3fedce60a02f4c0f7b6ebdf9379cf68ced","license":"Apache-2.0"},"contracts/storage/ConvictionStakingStorage.sol":{"content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0\n\npragma solidity ^0.8.20;\n\nimport {Chronos} from \"./Chronos.sol\";\nimport {Guardian} from \"../Guardian.sol\";\nimport {ICustodian} from \"../interfaces/ICustodian.sol\";\nimport {INamed} from \"../interfaces/INamed.sol\";\nimport {IVersioned} from \"../interfaces/IVersioned.sol\";\nimport {HubLib} from \"../libraries/HubLib.sol\";\nimport {StakingLib} from \"../libraries/StakingLib.sol\";\nimport {IERC20} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/IERC20.sol\";\nimport {SafeERC20} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/utils/SafeERC20.sol\";\n\n/**\n * @title ConvictionStakingStorage\n * @notice Primary accounting store AND TRAC vault for V10 staking.\n *\n * V10 architecture (post-consolidation, v4.0.0):\n *   - CSS is the single source of truth for V10 staking: NFT-keyed positions,\n *     per-node stake aggregates, per-epoch operator-fee/net-rewards flags,\n *     per-node operator-fee balances + withdrawal queue, AND the TRAC vault.\n *     There is no separate `StakingStorage` in the V10 hot path.\n *   - The TRAC custody role moved here from V8 `StakingStorage` in v4.0.0:\n *     CSS now extends `Guardian`, so its `tokenContract` reference and\n *     `transferStake` outflow function come from the same base every V10\n *     publish/payment contract uses for vault-routed deposits. Vault-target\n *     consumers (`KnowledgeAssetsLifecycle`, `DKGKnowledgeAssets`, `Paymaster`,\n *     `PublishingConvictionAccount`, `DKGPublishingConvictionNFT`,\n *     `DKGStakingConvictionNFT`) resolve `hub.getContractAddress(\"ConvictionStakingStorage\")`\n *     for both deposits (TRAC `transferFrom` to CSS) and withdrawals\n *     (`StakingV10` calls `cs.transferStake`).\n *   - Migration to V10 is MANDATORY: every V8 delegator becomes a V10 NFT\n *     position. `RandomSampling.calculateNodeScore` therefore reads the\n *     timestamp-accurate effective stake here (raw TRAC \u00d7 active conviction\n *     multipliers), while raw stake gates still read `nodeStakeV10`. V8\n *     `StakingStorage` is deployed-but-unused dead code post-consolidation;\n *     only `StakingV10._convertToNFT` reads it (V8\u2192V10 drain at cutover).\n *\n * Rewards model (D19 \u2014 compound-into-raw):\n *   - The previous split-bucket model (separate `rewards` sidecar that\n *     always earned 1x) has been removed. Claimed rewards compound into\n *     `raw`, so they take on the position's current lock multiplier.\n *   - `cumulativeRewardsClaimed` is now a statistic-only counter for\n *     UI/indexer consumption; it never enters effective-stake math.\n *\n * Tier model (D20 \u2014 mutable wall-clock tier ladder):\n *   - Tier durations and multipliers are stored in `_tiers` (keyed by\n *     `lockTier` id). The baseline ladder seeded at `initialize()` is\n *     {0\u2192(0s, 1x), 1\u2192(30d, 1.5x), 3\u2192(90d, 2x), 6\u2192(180d, 3.5x), 12\u2192(366d, 6x)}.\n *   - `expiryTimestamp = block.timestamp + duration`, rounded UP to the\n *     next 12-hour expiry bucket. The upward rounding keeps the promised\n *     minimum lock duration while coalescing per-block dust stakes into\n *     one queue slot per half-day.\n *   - New tiers can be appended via `addTier` (HubOwner or multisig owner).\n *     Existing tiers can be deactivated via `deactivateTier` to stop\n *     accepting NEW fresh stakes, but relock / migration paths still\n *     honor the original commitment (existence-only check). The model is\n *     additive-only: once added a tier id cannot be removed.\n *\n * Effective-stake accounting (D26 \u2014 timestamp-accurate):\n *   - Each node carries a `runningNodeEffectiveStake[id]` settled at\n *     `nodeLastSettledAt[id]`, plus a sorted queue of pending boost-\n *     expiry drops (`nodeExpiryTimes[id]` / `nodeExpiryDrop[id][ts]`)\n *     with a monotonic head cursor `nodeExpiryHead[id]`.\n *   - `settleNodeTo(id, ts)` advances the running stake to `ts` by\n *     draining all expiry entries whose timestamp is <= ts. Called by\n *     every CSS mutator before applying its own delta, and by\n *     `RandomSampling.submitProof` before integrating score.\n *   - This replaces the v2.x epoch-diff accumulator (effectiveStakeDiff,\n *     nodeEffectiveStakeDiff, lastFinalizedEpoch, finalize*). Past-epoch\n *     effective-stake snapshots are no longer reconstructable from CSS;\n *     consumers that need them should settle and read \"current\" state.\n */\ncontract ConvictionStakingStorage is INamed, IVersioned, Guardian {\n    using SafeERC20 for IERC20;\n\n    string private constant _NAME = \"ConvictionStakingStorage\";\n    // Version history:\n    //   1.1.0 \u2014 split-bucket rewards, discrete tier ladder.\n    //   1.2.0 \u2014 V10-native pending-withdrawal storage (create/delete/get).\n    //   2.0.0 \u2014 V10 canonical store (positions + per-node aggregates +\n    //           absorbed DelegatorsInfo + tier constants).\n    //   2.1.0 \u2014 Mutable D20 tier ladder (lockTier rename, _tiers mapping).\n    //   2.2.0 \u2014 D14/D25 atomic-withdraw & in-place redelegate (removed\n    //           PendingWithdrawal).\n    //   3.0.0 \u2014 D26 timestamp-accurate effective-stake accounting:\n    //           * `Position.expiryEpoch` \u2192 `Position.expiryTimestamp`\n    //             (uint40 seconds-since-unix-epoch, NOT a Chronos epoch).\n    //           * Per-node running effective-stake with a sorted pending-\n    //             expiry queue. Epoch-diff accumulator, finalize helpers\n    //             and their dirty cursors removed.\n    //           * `BLOCK_DRIFT_BUFFER` removed (no longer meaningful).\n    //   3.1.0 \u2014 D26 code-review follow-ups:\n    //           * M1 \u2014 `updateOnRelock` removed; `createNewPositionFromExisting`\n    //             simplified to same-identity-only (cross-identity branch was\n    //             unreachable \u2014 `redelegate` goes through `updateOnRedelegate`).\n    //           * M2 \u2014 `nodeExpiryPresent` mapping added so a cancel\u2192reschedule\n    //             at the same `ts` doesn't duplicate the queue slot.\n    //           * M3/M4 \u2014 `addTier` rejects degenerate tier configs\n    //             (tier 0 must be rest state; non-zero tier needs both a\n    //             positive duration and a >1x multiplier).\n    //           * L4 \u2014 `createPosition` guards against `currentEpoch == 0`.\n    //           * L5 \u2014 `_cancelNodeExpiry` `delete`s the slot when the\n    //             remaining drop hits zero (refunds SSTORE).\n    //           * L7 \u2014 `getNodeEffectiveStakeAtEpoch` tolerates Chronos\n    //             returning 0 for unanchored epochs.\n    //           * L9 \u2014 `setV10LaunchEpoch` is one-shot (anchor cannot be\n    //             silently rebound).\n    //           * L11 \u2014 `createPosition` no longer takes `multiplier18`;\n    //             it reads the multiplier from the tier table.\n    //   4.0.0 \u2014 Storage consolidation: CSS absorbs the TRAC vault role and\n    //           operator-fee accounting from V8 `StakingStorage`.\n    //           * Base contract switched from `HubDependent` \u2192 `Guardian`\n    //             (CSS now holds `tokenContract`, exposes `transferStake`,\n    //             and inherits the misplaced-token rescue helpers).\n    //           * Added `nodeOperatorFeeBalance` (per-node fee accrual the\n    //             `StakingV10._claim` operator split previously wrote to\n    //             `StakingStorage.nodes[id].operatorFeeBalance`).\n    //           * Added `operatorFeeWithdrawals` (per-node request queue\n    //             with the V8 `StakeWithdrawalRequest` struct shape so the\n    //             `StakingV10` admin surface can be added without further\n    //             struct churn).\n    //           * Vault deposits across V10 (`KnowledgeAssetsV10`,\n    //             `DKGKnowledgeAssets`, `Paymaster`, etc.) now route TRAC\n    //             into the CSS address. `StakingStorage` is no longer in\n    //             the V10 hot path; only `StakingV10._convertToNFT` reads\n    //             it (V8\u2192V10 drain at cutover).\n    //   4.1.0 \u2014 V8\u2192V10 migration conviction credit.\n    //           * `createPosition` gains a sixth parameter\n    //             `expiryShortenedBy` (seconds). Subtracted from the\n    //             tier-default `expiryTimestamp` after the standard\n    //             computation so callers (presently\n    //             `StakingV10._convertToNFT`) can grant a one-time time\n    //             credit to V8 delegators who held continuous stake for\n    //             the 60 days preceding V10 launch. Validated against\n    //             `_tierDuration(lockTier)` and the current block\n    //             timestamp; tier-0 callers MUST pass 0.\n    //   10.0.3 \u2014 Reward carries (audit fix: mid-epoch redelegate/relock\n    //           orphaned the current epoch's settled delegator score).\n    //           * NEW `RewardCarry` struct + `rewardCarries` mapping:\n    //             pointers to RSS (epoch, identityId, delegatorKey) score\n    //             slots that the position's CURRENT node/key no longer\n    //             reaches. Written by `StakingV10.redelegate` / `relock`,\n    //             drained by `StakingV10._claim`.\n    //           * `createNewPositionFromExisting` migrates carries across\n    //             the relock burn-mint; `deletePosition` deletes them.\n    //   10.0.5 \u2014 Expiry-queue DoS hardening:\n    //           * Boost expiries are rounded up to 12-hour buckets so\n    //             per-block dust stakes coalesce into one queue slot per\n    //             half-day.\n    //           * New distinct expiry slots are capped per node; same-bucket\n    //             stakes keep coalescing even when the cap is reached.\n    //   10.0.6 \u2014 Audit G-6: increaseRaw/decreaseRaw install a position's running-\n    //             stake / boost contribution as the ONE-SHOT delta from its raw\n    //             (floor(newRaw*m) - floor(oldRaw*m)), so a reward-compounded\n    //             position's contribution always equals the one-shot value the\n    //             unwind paths remove. This eliminates the incremental-vs-one-shot\n    //             floor asymmetry that bricked redelegate/relock/exit/decreaseRaw,\n    //             with the strict cancel/stake-delta invariants kept intact.\n    string private constant _VERSION = \"10.0.6\";\n\n    // Multiplier scale, matches DKGStakingConvictionNFT._convictionMultiplier\n    // (returns 1e18-scaled values so fractional tiers like 1.5x and 3.5x\n    // are representable).\n    uint256 internal constant SCALE18 = 1e18;\n    uint40 public constant EXPIRY_BUCKET_SECONDS = 12 hours;\n    uint256 public constant MAX_NODE_PENDING_EXPIRIES = 1024;\n    /// @notice Maximum boosted lock-tier duration. Bounded so the distinct future\n    ///         buckets a node can ever hold stays STRICTLY below the slot cap.\n    ///         Because `_computeExpiryTimestamp` rounds UP to the next bucket, a\n    ///         tier of `k` buckets created just after a boundary expires `k + 1`\n    ///         buckets out \u2014 so a node staking once per bucket can reach `k + 1`\n    ///         distinct pending slots. To keep that `<= MAX_NODE_PENDING_EXPIRIES`,\n    ///         a tier must be at most `MAX_NODE_PENDING_EXPIRIES - 1` buckets\n    ///         (`1023 * 12h = 511.5 days`). With this enforced in `addTier`,\n    ///         `MAX_NODE_PENDING_EXPIRIES` can never be reached by valid stakes \u2014\n    ///         it stays a pure backstop and never blocks a legitimate stake/relock\n    ///         (and the tombstone-vs-live slot distinction can never bite). The\n    ///         baseline ladder tops out at 366 days, well under this.\n    uint256 public constant MAX_TIER_DURATION =\n        (MAX_NODE_PENDING_EXPIRIES - 1) * uint256(EXPIRY_BUCKET_SECONDS);\n\n    // ============================================================\n    //                 D20 \u2014 Mutable tier ladder\n    // ============================================================\n\n    // Tier definition. `duration` is the committed wall-clock lock\n    // (seconds) passed to `_computeExpiryTimestamp`. `multiplier18` is the\n    // 1e18-scaled effective-stake multiplier applied pre-expiry.\n    //\n    // `active` gates NEW fresh stakes (createPosition with migrationEpoch==0).\n    // Relock and migration paths take the existence-only path so the user's\n    // original commitment is honored even if a tier has since been retired.\n    //\n    // `exists` distinguishes a never-added tier id from a deactivated one.\n    struct TierConfig {\n        uint256 duration;\n        uint64 multiplier18;\n        bool active;\n        bool exists;\n    }\n\n    // Position layout (two storage slots \u2014 V10 compound-into-raw model):\n    //   slot 1: raw(96) + lockTier(40) + expiryTimestamp(40) + identityId(72) = 248 bits\n    //   slot 2: cumulativeRewardsClaimed(96) + multiplier18(64)\n    //           + lastClaimedEpoch(32) + migrationEpoch(32)                 = 224 bits\n    //\n    // Field semantics:\n    //   raw                        \u2014 principal (+ compounded rewards). Earns\n    //                                `multiplier18` while `block.timestamp <\n    //                                expiryTimestamp`, drops back to 1x\n    //                                thereafter. Claim compounds TRAC into\n    //                                this field.\n    //   lockTier                   \u2014 tier identifier from the mutable ladder\n    //                                in `_tiers`. Baseline set is\n    //                                {0, 1, 3, 6, 12} (30d / 90d / 180d /\n    //                                366d wall-clock locks).\n    //   expiryTimestamp            \u2014 Unix timestamp (seconds) at which the\n    //                                boost drops. 0 iff lockTier == 0 (rest\n    //                                state). uint40 holds ~34k years.\n    //   identityId                 \u2014 the node this position delegates to.\n    //   cumulativeRewardsClaimed   \u2014 D19 statistic: total TRAC ever compounded\n    //                                into `raw` via claim for this NFT.\n    //   multiplier18               \u2014 materialized copy of `_tierMultiplier(lockTier)`.\n    //   lastClaimedEpoch           \u2014 Chronos epoch of the last successful claim.\n    //   migrationEpoch             \u2014 D6: V8\u2192V10 retroactive-claim boundary.\n    //                                0 means \"fresh V10 stake\".\n    struct Position {\n        uint96 raw;\n        uint40 lockTier;\n        uint40 expiryTimestamp;\n        uint72 identityId;\n        // slot 2\n        uint96 cumulativeRewardsClaimed;\n        uint64 multiplier18;\n        uint32 lastClaimedEpoch;\n        uint32 migrationEpoch;\n    }\n\n    event PositionCreated(\n        uint256 indexed tokenId,\n        uint72 indexed identityId,\n        uint96 raw,\n        uint40 lockTier,\n        uint40 expiryTimestamp,\n        uint64 multiplier18,\n        uint32 migrationEpoch\n    );\n    event PositionRedelegated(\n        uint256 indexed tokenId,\n        uint72 indexed oldIdentityId,\n        uint72 indexed newIdentityId\n    );\n    event PositionDeleted(uint256 indexed tokenId);\n    // D21+D23 \u2014 ephemeral NFT for `relock` only. The old tokenId is burned\n    // and a fresh one is minted under a new tier. Off-chain indexers trace a\n    // position's history across the burn-mint via the (oldTokenId, newTokenId)\n    // link in this event.\n    event PositionReplaced(\n        uint256 indexed oldTokenId,\n        uint256 indexed newTokenId,\n        uint72 indexed newIdentityId,\n        uint96 raw,\n        uint40 newLockTier,\n        uint40 newExpiryTimestamp,\n        uint64 newMultiplier18\n    );\n    event LastClaimedEpochUpdated(uint256 indexed tokenId, uint32 epoch);\n    event MigrationEpochSet(uint256 indexed tokenId, uint32 epoch);\n    // D19 \u2014 compound-into-raw model.\n    event RawIncreased(uint256 indexed tokenId, uint96 amount, uint96 newRaw);\n    event RawDecreased(uint256 indexed tokenId, uint96 amount, uint96 newRaw);\n    event CumulativeRewardsClaimedUpdated(uint256 indexed tokenId, uint96 added, uint96 newTotal);\n    // D26 \u2014 running-effective-stake settlement.\n    event NodeEffectiveStakeSettled(\n        uint72 indexed identityId,\n        uint40 fromTimestamp,\n        uint40 toTimestamp,\n        uint256 newRunningEffectiveStake\n    );\n    event NodeEffectiveStakeDelta(uint72 indexed identityId, int256 delta, uint256 newRunningEffectiveStake);\n    event NodeExpiryScheduled(uint72 indexed identityId, uint40 timestamp, uint256 dropAdded, uint256 newTotalDrop);\n    event NodeExpiryCancelled(uint72 indexed identityId, uint40 timestamp, uint256 dropRemoved, uint256 newTotalDrop);\n    error NodeExpiryQueueFull(uint72 identityId, uint256 pending, uint256 maxPending);\n    // D15 \u2014 V10 stake aggregate events.\n    event NodeStakeV10Increased(uint72 indexed identityId, uint256 amount, uint256 newNodeStake, uint256 newTotal);\n    event NodeStakeV10Decreased(uint72 indexed identityId, uint256 amount, uint256 newNodeStake, uint256 newTotal);\n    // D7 \u2014 V10 launch marker.\n    event V10LaunchEpochSet(uint256 epoch);\n    // D3 \u2014 DelegatorsInfo-absorbed events.\n    event IsOperatorFeeClaimedForEpochUpdated(uint72 indexed identityId, uint256 indexed epoch, bool isClaimed);\n    event NetNodeEpochRewardsSet(uint72 indexed identityId, uint256 indexed epoch, uint256 amount);\n\n    Chronos public chronos;\n\n    mapping(uint256 => Position) public positions;\n\n    // ============================================================\n    //    D26 \u2014 Running effective-stake state per node\n    // ============================================================\n    //\n    // Invariant: `runningNodeEffectiveStake[id]` is the node's effective\n    // stake AT `nodeLastSettledAt[id]` (inclusive). All expiries whose\n    // timestamp is <= nodeLastSettledAt[id] have already been applied\n    // (dropped from the running stake). All entries in `nodeExpiryTimes[id]`\n    // at indices >= nodeExpiryHead[id] have timestamps strictly greater\n    // than nodeLastSettledAt[id].\n    // Slither: mappings are zero-initialized by the language \u2014 see\n    // ContextGraphStorage._participantAgents for the long-form rationale.\n    // slither-disable-next-line uninitialized-state\n    mapping(uint72 => uint256) public runningNodeEffectiveStake;\n    // slither-disable-next-line uninitialized-state\n    mapping(uint72 => uint40) public nodeLastSettledAt;\n\n    // Sorted-ascending queue of pending boost-expiry timestamps per node.\n    // We only append past index `nodeExpiryHead[id]`; partially-cancelled\n    // entries stay physically present at their sorted position and drain\n    // with whatever drop remains. Fully-cancelled entries (drop back to 0\n    // before drain) are kept as \"zero-drop\" slots so that when a fresh\n    // expiry lands at the same `ts`, `nodeExpiryPresent` prevents us from\n    // pushing a duplicate (M2).\n    mapping(uint72 => uint40[]) internal nodeExpiryTimes;\n    // Aggregate boost drop scheduled at exactly `ts` for `id`. Multiple\n    // positions sharing an `expiryTimestamp` are coalesced here.\n    mapping(uint72 => mapping(uint40 => uint256)) internal nodeExpiryDrop;\n    // Drain cursor into `nodeExpiryTimes[id]`. Entries below the head\n    // are fully drained and MUST NOT be read again.\n    mapping(uint72 => uint256) internal nodeExpiryHead;\n    // M2 \u2014 tracks whether `ts` has a live slot in `nodeExpiryTimes[id]`\n    //      at or past `nodeExpiryHead[id]`. Set on first schedule, cleared\n    //      when the drain cursor walks past the slot. Without this, a\n    //      cancel-to-zero followed by a fresh schedule at the same `ts`\n    //      would push a second entry (functionally harmless, but doubles\n    //      the SSTOREs and weakens the \"at most one entry per `ts`\"\n    //      invariant on `nodeExpiryTimes[id]`).\n    mapping(uint72 => mapping(uint40 => bool)) internal nodeExpiryPresent;\n\n    // ============================================================\n    //                D5 \u2014 Per-node tokenId enumeration\n    // ============================================================\n    mapping(uint72 => uint256[]) public nodeTokens;\n    mapping(uint72 => mapping(uint256 => uint256)) public nodeTokenIndex;\n\n    // ============================================================\n    //           D15 \u2014 V10 stake aggregates (raw TRAC principal)\n    // ============================================================\n    mapping(uint72 => uint256) public nodeStakeV10;\n    uint256 public totalStakeV10;\n\n    // ============================================================\n    //            D3 \u2014 Absorbed DelegatorsInfo fields (V10)\n    // ============================================================\n    mapping(uint72 => mapping(uint256 => bool)) public isOperatorFeeClaimedForEpoch;\n    mapping(uint72 => mapping(uint256 => uint256)) public netNodeEpochRewards;\n\n    // ============================================================\n    //   v4.0.0 \u2014 Operator-fee balance + withdrawal queue (absorbed\n    //            from V8 StakingStorage)\n    //\n    // `nodeOperatorFeeBalance` accrues each time `StakingV10._claim`\n    // splits gross node rewards by `Profile.getLatestOperatorFeePercentage`\n    // (operator-fee-percentage cut, drained when the operator finalises a\n    // `requestOperatorFeeWithdrawal` / `cancelOperatorFeeWithdrawal` against\n    // their identity).\n    //\n    // `operatorFeeWithdrawals` is the per-identity request queue. The struct\n    // shape is reused from `StakingLib.StakeWithdrawalRequest` so the\n    // operator-side admin functions can be added on `StakingV10` (or on a\n    // future thin admin contract) without further struct churn. V10 never\n    // populates `indexedOutAmount`; it stays 0 for every entry.\n    // ============================================================\n    mapping(uint72 => uint96) public nodeOperatorFeeBalance;\n    mapping(uint72 => StakingLib.StakeWithdrawalRequest) public operatorFeeWithdrawals;\n\n    // ============================================================\n    //                 D7 \u2014 V10 launch epoch marker\n    // ============================================================\n    uint256 public v10LaunchEpoch;\n\n    // ============================================================\n    //   V8\u2192V10 \"pool & allocate\" migration credit ledger\n    // ============================================================\n    // Migrated-but-unallocated TRAC, per delegator. Backed 1:1 by TRAC\n    // physically held in THIS contract (moved here by the drain worker via\n    // StakingStorage.transferStake). The only sink is `spendMigrationCredit`\n    // (driven by DKGStakingConvictionNFT.allocate) \u2014 credit is NEVER\n    // withdrawable to a wallet. Lives here (durable storage), not on the\n    // wrapper (logic), so a wrapper redeploy mid-migration cannot strand the\n    // already-moved TRAC.\n    mapping(address => uint96) public migrationCredit;\n    // Lock-shortening (seconds) applied to ANY tier-6/12 migration allocation\n    // (universal \u2014 no per-staker eligibility distinction). Set\n    // at cutover via `setConvictionCreditSeconds`, capped below the shortest\n    // credited-tier (tier 6) duration so a position's expiry cannot underflow.\n    // 0 until set (no credit).\n    uint40 public convictionCreditSeconds;\n\n    // ============================================================\n    //           D20 (v2.1.0) \u2014 Mutable tier-ladder storage\n    // ============================================================\n    mapping(uint40 => TierConfig) internal _tiers;\n    uint40[] public tierIds;\n\n    // ============================================================\n    //   v10.0.3 \u2014 Reward carries (mid-epoch redelegate / relock)\n    // ============================================================\n    //\n    // A mid-epoch `redelegate` flips `pos.identityId`, and a `relock`\n    // re-keys the position under a fresh tokenId. In both cases the\n    // delegator score already settled in RandomSamplingStorage under the\n    // OLD (epoch, identityId, delegatorKey) slot becomes unreachable from\n    // `StakingV10._claim`, which reads only the position's CURRENT node +\n    // key \u2014 silently forfeiting up to one epoch's rewards. Each carry is\n    // a POINTER to such a slot; the score value itself stays in RSS.\n    // `StakingV10._claim` integrates matured carries (epoch closed) and\n    // clears them.\n    struct RewardCarry {\n        uint72 identityId;\n        uint32 epoch;\n        bytes32 delegatorKey;\n    }\n\n    // Bounded so a position's claim/withdraw can never be self-bricked by\n    // an excessive number of same-epoch redelegations (carries from past\n    // epochs are flushed on every claim).\n    uint256 public constant MAX_REWARD_CARRIES = 32;\n\n    mapping(uint256 => RewardCarry[]) internal rewardCarries;\n\n    event RewardCarryAdded(\n        uint256 indexed tokenId,\n        uint72 indexed identityId,\n        uint32 epoch,\n        bytes32 delegatorKey\n    );\n    event RewardCarriesCleared(uint256 indexed tokenId, uint32 maxEpoch, uint256 removed);\n\n    // ============================================================\n    //          Tier admin events (v2.1.0)\n    // ============================================================\n    event TierAdded(uint40 indexed lockTier, uint256 duration, uint64 multiplier18);\n    event TierDeactivated(uint40 indexed lockTier);\n    event ConvictionCreditSecondsSet(uint40 secondsValue);\n\n    // ============================================================\n    //   v4.0.0 \u2014 Vault + operator-fee events (absorbed from V8 SS)\n    // ============================================================\n    event OperatorFeeBalanceUpdated(uint72 indexed identityId, uint96 feeBalance);\n    event OperatorFeeWithdrawalRequestCreated(\n        uint72 indexed identityId,\n        uint96 amount,\n        uint96 indexedOutAmount,\n        uint256 timestamp\n    );\n    event OperatorFeeWithdrawalRequestDeleted(uint72 indexed identityId);\n    event StakedTokensTransferred(address indexed receiver, uint96 amount);\n    /// @notice OT-RFC-53: emitted when the protocol treasury fee owed on an\n    ///         escrow-funded publish/update/extend is routed out of the vault to\n    ///         the treasury. The\n            // exact second is preserved on purpose \u2014 do not \"tidy\" this onto the grid.\n            expiryTimestamp = uint40(uint256(expiryTimestamp) - uint256(expiryShortenedBy));\n            require(expiryTimestamp > tsNow, \"Credit leaves no remaining lock\");\n        }\n\n        positions[tokenId] = Position({\n            raw: raw,\n            lockTier: lockTier,\n            expiryTimestamp: expiryTimestamp,\n            identityId: identityId,\n            cumulativeRewardsClaimed: 0,\n            multiplier18: multiplier18,\n            lastClaimedEpoch: uint32(currentEpoch - 1),\n            migrationEpoch: migrationEpoch\n        });\n\n        _pushNodeToken(identityId, tokenId);\n        _increaseNodeStakeV10(identityId, uint256(raw));\n\n        _settleNodeTo(identityId, tsNow);\n\n        // Effective contribution right now = raw * multiplier18 / 1e18.\n        uint256 effNow = (uint256(raw) * uint256(multiplier18)) / SCALE18;\n        _applyNodeStakeDelta(identityId, int256(effNow));\n\n        // Schedule the boost drop at expiry (if there is any boost).\n        if (lockTier > 0 && multiplier18 > SCALE18) {\n            uint256 boost = (uint256(raw) * (uint256(multiplier18) - SCALE18)) / SCALE18;\n            _scheduleNodeExpiry(identityId, expiryTimestamp, boost);\n        }\n\n        emit PositionCreated(tokenId, identityId, raw, lockTier, expiryTimestamp, multiplier18, migrationEpoch);\n    }\n\n    // M1 \u2014 `updateOnRelock` was never reached from production contracts\n    //      (StakingV10.relock goes through `createNewPositionFromExisting`,\n    //      which preserves reward continuity under the D21 \"NFTs are\n    //      ephemeral across tier changes\" narrative). Removing eliminates\n    //      a silent dead-code path and clarifies that relock is a\n    //      burn-and-mint, not an in-place tier swap.\n\n    function updateOnRedelegate(uint256 tokenId, uint72 newIdentityId) external onlyContracts {\n        require(newIdentityId != 0, \"Zero node\");\n        Position storage pos = positions[tokenId];\n        require(pos.identityId != 0, \"No position\");\n        uint72 oldIdentityId = pos.identityId;\n        require(oldIdentityId != newIdentityId, \"Same node\");\n\n        uint40 tsNow = uint40(block.timestamp);\n        uint96 raw = pos.raw;\n        uint40 expiryTs = pos.expiryTimestamp;\n        uint64 multiplier18 = pos.multiplier18;\n        bool stillBoosted = expiryTs != 0 && tsNow < expiryTs;\n\n        uint256 effectiveNow = stillBoosted\n            ? (uint256(raw) * uint256(multiplier18)) / SCALE18\n            : uint256(raw);\n        uint256 boost = (stillBoosted && multiplier18 > SCALE18)\n            ? Preserves `cumulativeRewardsClaimed`,\n     *         `lastClaimedEpoch`, and `migrationEpoch`; the new position's\n     *         lock clock starts at `block.timestamp` under the caller-\n     *         supplied tier.\n     *\n     * @dev M1 + L11 \u2014 post-review:\n     *        * Cross-identity branch removed. `StakingV10.redelegate`\n     *          goes through `updateOnRedelegate`; the only live caller\n     *          of this helper is `StakingV10.relock`, which stays on\n     *          the same node.\n     *        * `multiplier18` is no longer an argument; CSS reads it\n     *          from the tier table to avoid round-tripping data the\n     *          contract can derive on its own.\n     */\n    function createNewPositionFromExisting(\n        uint256 oldTokenId,\n        uint256 newTokenId,\n        uint72 identityId,\n        uint40 newLockTier\n    ) external onlyContracts {\n        require(identityId != 0, \"Zero node\");\n        require(positions[newTokenId].identityId == 0, \"New token used\");\n        require(oldTokenId != newTokenId, \"Same tokenId\");\n\n        Position memory old = positions[oldTokenId];\n        require(old.identityId != 0, \"No position\");\n        require(old.identityId == identityId, \"Identity mismatch\");\n        uint96 raw = old.raw;\n        require(raw > 0, \"Zero raw\");\n\n        uint64 newMultiplier18 = _tierMultiplier(newLockTier);\n\n        uint40 oldExpiryTs = old.expiryTimestamp;\n        uint64 oldMultiplier18 = old.multiplier18;\n        uint40 tsNow = uint40(block.timestamp);\n\n        _settleNodeTo(identityId, tsNow);\n\n        // --- Unwind old contribution ---\n        bool oldStillBoosted = oldExpiryTs != 0 && tsNow < oldExpiryTs;\n        uint256 effectiveNowOld = oldStillBoosted\n            ? (uint256(raw) * uint256(oldMultiplier18)) / SCALE18\n            : uint256(raw);\n        _applyNodeStakeDelta(identityId, -int256(effectiveNowOld));\n        if (oldStillBoosted && oldMultiplier18 > SCALE18) {\n            uint256 oldBoost = (uint256(raw) * (uint256(oldMultiplier18) - SCALE18)) / SCALE18;\n            _cancelNodeExpiry(identityId, oldExpiryTs, oldBoost);\n        }\n\n        // --- Install new contribution (fresh lock starts now) ---\n        uint40 newExpiryTs = _computeExpiryTimestamp(newLockTier);\n        uint256 effectiveNowNew = (uint256(raw) * uint256(newMultiplier18)) / SCALE18;\n        _applyNodeStakeDelta(identityId, int256(effectiveNowNew));\n        if (newLockTier > 0 && newMultiplier18 > SCALE18) {\n            uint256 newBoost = (uint256(raw) * (uint256(newMultiplier18) - SCALE18)) / SCALE18;\n            _scheduleNodeExpiry(identityId, newExpiryTs, newBoost);\n        }\n\n        // --- Write new position preserving stats; delete old ---\n        positions[newTokenId] = Position({\n            raw: raw,\n            lockTier: newLockTier,\n            expiryTimestamp: newExpiryTs,\n            identityId: identityId,\n            cumulativeRewardsClaimed: old.cumulativeRewardsClaimed,\n            multiplier18: newMultiplier18,\n            lastClaimedEpoch: old.lastClaimedEpoch,\n            migrationEpoch: old.migrationEpoch\n        });\n        delete positions[oldTokenId];\n\n        // --- Per-node enumeration ---\n        _popNodeToken(identityId, oldTokenId);\n        _pushNodeToken(identityId, newTokenId);\n\n        // v10.0.3 \u2014 carries follow the position across the burn-mint so\n        // same-epoch redelegate\u2192relock sequences keep their pointers.\n        // `newTokenId` is freshly minted (monotonic counter, \"New token\n        // used\" guard above) so its carry list starts empty.\n        RewardCarry[] storage oldCarries = rewardCarries[oldTokenId];\n        uint256 carryCount = oldCarries.length;\n        if (carryCount > 0) {\n            RewardCarry[] storage newCarries = rewardCarries[newTokenId];\n            for (uint256 i; i < carryCount; i++) {\n                newCarries.push(oldCarries[i]);\n            }\n            delete rewardCarries[oldTokenId];\n        }\n\n        // nodeStakeV10 is invariant \u2014 same identity, same raw. No emit.\n\n        emit PositionReplaced(\n            oldTokenId,\n            newTokenId,\n            identityId,\n            raw,\n            newLockTier,\n            newExpiryTs,\n            newMultiplier18\n        );\n    }\n\n    function setLastClaimedEpoch(uint256 tokenId, uint32 epoch) external onlyContracts {\n        require(positions[tokenId].identityId != 0, \"No position\");\n        positions[tokenId].lastClaimedEpoch = epoch;\n        emit LastClaimedEpochUpdated(tokenId, epoch);\n    }\n\n    // ============================================================\n    //        v10.0.3 \u2014 Reward-carry mutators (see struct docs)\n    // ============================================================\n\n    /// @notice Record a pointer to an RSS delegator-score slot the\n    ///         position's current node/key no longer reaches. Idempotent\n    ///         per (identityId, epoch, delegatorKey): the RSS slot\n    ///         accumulates across repeat visits (e.g. A\u2192B\u2192A\u2192C in one\n    ///         epoch), so a single pointer integrates all of them.\n    function addRewardCarry(\n        uint256 tokenId,\n        uint72 identityId,\n        uint32 epoch,\n        bytes32 delegatorKey\n    ) external onlyContracts {\n        require(positions[tokenId].identityId != 0, \"No position\");\n        RewardCarry[] storage list = rewardCarries[tokenId];\n        uint256 len = list.length;\n        for (uint256 i; i < len; i++) {\n            RewardCarry storage c = list[i];\n            if (c.identityId == identityId && c.epoch == epoch && c.delegatorKey == delegatorKey) {\n                return;\n            }\n        }\n        require(len < MAX_REWARD_CARRIES, \"Carry limit\");\n        list.push(RewardCarry({identityId: identityId, epoch: epoch, delegatorKey: delegatorKey}));\n        emit RewardCarryAdded(tokenId, identityId, epoch, delegatorKey);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Drop every carry with `epoch <= maxEpoch` (already\n    ///         integrated by the caller's claim pass). Swap-and-pop from\n    ///         the tail so each swapped-in element was already visited.\n    function clearRewardCarries(uint256 tokenId, uint32 maxEpoch) external onlyContracts {\n        RewardCarry[] storage list = rewardCarries[tokenId];\n        uint256 removed;\n        uint256 i = list.length;\n        while (i > 0) {\n            i--;\n            if (list[i].epoch <= maxEpoch) {\n                list[i] = list[list.length - 1];\n                list.pop();\n                removed++;\n            }\n        }\n        if (removed > 0) {\n            emit RewardCarriesCleared(tokenId, maxEpoch, removed);\n        }\n    }\n\n    function getRewardCarries(uint256 tokenId) external view returns (RewardCarry[] memory) {\n        return rewardCarries[tokenId];\n    }\n\n    function setMigrationEpoch(uint256 tokenId, uint32 epoch) external onlyContracts {\n        require(positions[tokenId].identityId != 0, \"No position\");\n        positions[tokenId].migrationEpoch = epoch;\n        emit MigrationEpochSet(tokenId, epoch);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Set the V10 retroactive-claim anchor (D7). Prevents an admin (or a\n    ///         compromised admin) from silently rebinding the reward-history\n    ///         boundary mid-life.\n    function setV10LaunchEpoch(uint256 epoch) external onlyContracts {\n        require(v10LaunchEpoch == 0, \"V10 launch already set\");\n        v10LaunchEpoch = epoch;\n        emit V10LaunchEpochSet(epoch);\n    }\n\n    // ============================================================\n    //   Migration credit ledger mutators (onlyContracts)\n    // ============================================================\n\n    /// @notice Credit `delegator` with migrated TRAC. Driven by StakingV10's\n    ///         drain worker after the TRAC has been physically moved into this\n    ///         contract.\n    function addMigrationCredit(address delegator, uint96 total) external onlyContracts {\n        migrationCredit[delegator] += total;\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Spend `amount` of `staker`'s migration credit for one allocation.\n    ///         Whether the tier-6/12 lock-credit applies is decided by the caller\n    ///         (StakingV10's allocate worker) from the chosen tier \u2014 there is no\n    ///         per-staker eligibility, so the spend is a plain debit.\n    function spendMigrationCredit(address staker, uint96 amount) external onlyContracts {\n        require(amount > 0, \"Zero amount\");\n        require(amount <= migrationCredit[staker], \"Amount exceeds credit\");\n        migrationCredit[staker] -= amount;\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Set the V8\u2192V10 conviction lock-credit (seconds). The owner gate lives on the\n    ///         DKGStakingConvictionNFT entrypoint that drives this.\n    function setConvictionCreditSeconds(uint40 secondsValue) external onlyContracts {\n        require(uint256(secondsValue) < _tierDuration(6), \"credit >= tier-6 lock\");\n        convictionCreditSeconds = secondsValue;\n        emit ConvictionCreditSecondsSet(secondsValue);\n    }\n\n    function deletePosition(uint256 tokenId) external onlyContracts {\n        Position memory pos = positions[tokenId];\n        require(pos.identityId != 0, \"No position\");\n\n        uint40 tsNow = uint40(block.timestamp);\n        uint96 raw = pos.raw;\n        uint72 identityId = pos.identityId;\n        uint40 expiryTs = pos.expiryTimestamp;\n        uint64 multiplier18 = pos.multiplier18;\n        bool stillBoosted = expiryTs != 0 && tsNow < expiryTs;\n\n        _settleNodeTo(identityId, tsNow);\n\n        uint256 effectiveNow = stillBoosted\n            ? (uint256(raw) * uint256(multiplier18)) / SCALE18\n            : uint256(raw);\n        _applyNodeStakeDelta(identityId, -int256(effectiveNow));\n        if (stillBoosted && multiplier18 > SCALE18) {\n            uint256 boost = (uint256(raw) * (uint256(multiplier18) -
