delete operatorFeeWithdrawals[identityId];\n        emit OperatorFeeWithdrawalRequestDeleted(identityId);\n    }\n\n    function getOperatorFeeWithdrawalRequest(uint72 identityId) external view returns (uint96, uint96, uint256) {\n        StakingLib.StakeWithdrawalRequest memory wr = operatorFeeWithdrawals[identityId];\n        return (wr.amount, wr.indexedOutAmount, wr.timestamp);\n    }\n\n    function getOperatorFeeWithdrawalRequestAmount(uint72 identityId) external view returns (uint96) {\n        return operatorFeeWithdrawals[identityId].amount;\n    }\n\n    function getOperatorFeeWithdrawalRequestIndexedOutAmount(uint72 identityId) external view returns (uint96) {\n        return operatorFeeWithdrawals[identityId].indexedOutAmount;\n    }\n\n    function getOperatorFeeWithdrawalRequestTimestamp(uint72 identityId) external view returns (uint256) {\n        return operatorFeeWithdrawals[identityId].timestamp;\n    }\n\n    function operatorFeeWithdrawalRequestExists(uint72 identityId) external view returns (bool) {\n        return operatorFeeWithdrawals[identityId].amount != 0;\n    }\n\n    // ============================================================\n    //   v4.0.0 \u2014 TRAC vault outflow\n    //\n    // The CSS contract address is the V10 TRAC vault (deposits arrive via\n    // `transferFrom(staker, address(this), amount)` from publish/staking\n    // callers). `transferStake` (stake movement) and `transferRegistrationDepositFee`\n    // (OT-RFC-53 escrow treasury fee) are the outflow paths; both gated to Hub-\n    // registered contracts, mirroring V8 `StakingStorage.transferStake`.\n    // ============================================================\n\n    function transferStake(address receiver, uint96 stakeAmount) external onlyContracts {\n        // Slither: `safeTransfer` (SafeERC20) reverts on failure rather than\n        // returning false \u2014 the \"unchecked-transfer\" pattern Slither flags\n        // applies to the bare ERC20 `.transfer()` return-value path. This\n        // call site is the SAFE wrapper precisely BECAUSE the V10 design\n        // upgraded V8's bare `.transfer()` (see StakingStorage.transferStake)\n        // to SafeERC20. False positive \u2014 kept here as a directive for\n        // future maintainers debugging the report.\n        // slither-disable-next-line unchecked-transfer\n        tokenContract.safeTransfer(receiver, stakeAmount);\n        emit StakedTokensTransferred(receiver, stakeAmount);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice OT-RFC-53: routes the protocol treasury fee owed on an escrow-funded\n    ///         publish/update/extend out of the vault to `treasury`. The SECOND\n    ///         vault-outflow path; mirrors {transferStake} (gated to Hub contracts,\n    ///         SafeERC20). The caller (KnowledgeAssetsLifecycle) computes `amount`\n    ///         (bounded by the consumed escrow) and passes the configured\n    ///         `protocolTreasury`; CSS performs only the gated transfer.\n    function transferRegistrationDepositFee(address treasury, uint96 amount) external onlyContracts {\n        // slither-disable-next-line unchecked-transfer\n        tokenContract.safeTransfer(treasury, amount);\n        emit RegistrationDepositFeeTransferred(treasury, amount);\n    }\n\n    // ============================================================\n    //                       Internal helpers\n    // ============================================================\n\n    /**\n     * @dev Wall-clock expiry computation (D26). Boosts last at least the tier\n     *      duration and expire on the next 12-hour bucket. Returns 0 for tier-0\n     *      (permanent rest state).\n     */\n    function _computeExpiryTimestamp(uint40 lockTier) internal view returns (uint40) {\n        if (lockTier == 0) return 0;\n        uint256 duration = _tierDuration(lockTier);\n        uint256 exp = block.timestamp + duration;\n        return _bucketExpiryTimestamp(exp);\n    }\n\n    function _bucketExpiryTimestamp(uint256 rawExpiry) internal pure returns (uint40) {\n        uint256 bucket = uint256(EXPIRY_BUCKET_SECONDS);\n        uint256 bucketed = ((rawExpiry + bucket - 1) / bucket) * bucket;\n        require(bucketed <= type(uint40).max, \"Expiry overflow\");\n        return uint40(bucketed);\n    }\n\n    function _pushNodeToken(uint72 identityId, uint256 tokenId) internal {\n        nodeTokenIndex[identityId][tokenId] = nodeTokens[identityId].length;\n        nodeTokens[identityId].push(tokenId);\n    }\n\n    function _popNodeToken(uint72 identityId, uint256 tokenId) internal {\n        uint256[] storage arr = nodeTokens[identityId];\n        uint256 idx = nodeTokenIndex[identityId][tokenId];\n        uint256 last = arr.length - 1;\n        if (idx != last) {\n            uint256 movedToken = arr[last];\n            arr[idx] = movedToken;\n            nodeTokenIndex[identityId][movedToken] = idx;\n        }\n        arr.pop();\n        delete nodeTokenIndex[identityId][tokenId];\n    }\n\n    function _increaseNodeStakeV10(uint72 identityId, uint256 amount) internal {\n        nodeStakeV10[identityId] += amount;\n        totalStakeV10 += amount;\n        emit NodeStakeV10Increased(identityId, amount, nodeStakeV10[identityId], totalStakeV10);\n    }\n\n    function _decreaseNodeStakeV10(uint72 identityId, uint256 amount) internal {\n        nodeStakeV10[identityId] -= amount;\n        totalStakeV10 -= amount;\n        emit NodeStakeV10Decreased(identityId, amount, nodeStakeV10[identityId], totalStakeV10);\n    }\n}\n","keccak256":"0x52c35cbd4d06b4765f837089b13202cd1cca5023be8df9e481cdc00892acaa62","license":"Apache-2.0"},"contracts/storage/EpochStorage.sol":{"content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0\n\npragma solidity ^0.8.20;\n\nimport {Chronos} from \"./Chronos.sol\";\nimport {HubDependent} from \"../abstract/HubDependent.sol\";\nimport {INamed} from \"../interfaces/INamed.sol\";\nimport {IVersioned} from \"../interfaces/IVersioned.sol\";\n\ncontract EpochStorage is INamed, IVersioned, HubDependent {\n    string private constant _NAME = \"EpochStorage\";\n    // 10.0.4 \u2014 OT-RFC-51 \"Publishing Allocation\": the per-node\n    //          produced-knowledge-value accounting is repurposed as\n    //          committed PCA \"publishing allocation\". The mappings,\n    //          mutator, event, and getters are renamed\n    //          (`*ProducedKnowledgeValue*` -> `*PublishingAllocation*`)\n    //          and a net-zero `moveEpochPublishingAllocation` mutator is\n    //          added so a PCA can re-designate its primary node without\n    //          changing the epoch total (K_total).\n    string private constant _VERSION = \"10.0.4\";\n\n    event EpochPublishingAllocationAdded(uint72 indexed identityId, uint256 indexed epoch, uint96 amount);\n    event TokensAddedToEpochRange(\n        uint256 indexed shardId,\n        uint256 startEpoch,\n        uint256 endEpoch,\n        uint96 tokenAmount,\n        uint96 remainder\n    );\n    event EpochTokensPaidOut(uint256 indexed shardId, uint256 indexed epoch, uint72 indexed identityId, uint96 amount);\n    event EpochsFinalized(uint256 indexed shardId, uint256 startEpoch, uint256 endEpoch);\n\n    Chronos public chronos;\n\n    mapping(uint256 => uint256) public lastFinalizedEpoch;\n    mapping(uint256 => uint96) public accumulatedRemainder;\n\n    mapping(uint256 => mapping(uint256 => int96)) public diff;\n    mapping(uint256 => mapping(uint256 => uint96)) public cumulative;\n    mapping(uint256 => mapping(uint256 => uint96)) public distributed;\n\n    mapping(uint72 => mapping(uint256 => uint96)) public nodesEpochPublishingAllocation;\n    mapping(uint256 => uint96) public epochPublishingAllocation;\n    mapping(uint256 => uint96) public epochNodeMaxPublishingAllocation;\n\n    mapping(uint72 => mapping(uint256 => mapping(uint256 => uint96))) public nodesPaidOut;\n\n    constructor(address hubAddress) HubDependent(hubAddress) {}\n\n    function initialize() public onlyHub {\n        chronos = Chronos(hub.getContractAddress(\"Chronos\"));\n    }\n\n    function name() external pure virtual override returns (string memory) {\n        return _NAME;\n    }\n\n    function version() external pure virtual override returns (string memory) {\n        return _VERSION;\n    }\n\n    function addEpochPublishingAllocation(\n        uint72 identityId,\n        uint256 epoch,\n        uint96 amount\n    ) external onlyContracts {\n        nodesEpochPublishingAllocation[identityId][epoch] += amount;\n        epochPublishingAllocation[epoch] += amount;\n\n        // Maintain the per-epoch node max so its (public) getters stay\n        // consistent. The OT-RFC-51 scoring path does NOT read it\n        // (RandomSampling reads only getNodeEpochPublishingAllocation /\n        // getEpochPublishingAllocation), but the mapping cannot be removed \u2014\n        // it precedes `nodesPaidOut` in this persistent (non-fresh-state)\n        // storage layout \u2014 and leaving it written-nowhere/read-in-getters\n        // trips Slither's uninitialized-state finding. The compare/SSTORE is\n        // negligible against the surrounding accounting.\n        if (nodesEpochPublishingAllocation[identityId][epoch] > epochNodeMaxPublishingAllocation[epoch]) {\n            epochNodeMaxPublishingAllocation[epoch] = nodesEpochPublishingAllocation[identityId][epoch];\n        }\n\n        emit EpochPublishingAllocationAdded(identityId, epoch, amount);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice OT-RFC-51: move `amount` of publishing allocation from one\n    ///         node to another within a single `epoch`. Used when a PCA\n    ///         re-designates its primary node \u2014 the epoch total\n    ///         (`epochPublishingAllocation`, i.e. K_total) is intentionally\n    ///         NOT touched, so the move is net-zero on the denominator of\n    ///         every node's publishing factor.\n    /// @dev    `epochNodeMaxPublishingAllocation` is a per-epoch HIGH-WATER\n    ///         MARK, maintained identically on the add and move paths: it is\n    ///         only ever RAISED (when the destination's new value exceeds it),\n    ///         never lowered by the `fromId` decrement \u2014 computing the true\n    ///         current max after a decrement would need an O(nodes) scan.\n    ///         Nothing on-chain reads it (scoring reads only\n    ///         get(Node)EpochPublishingAllocation); it exists for off-chain\n    ///         observability, for which the high-water-mark semantic is correct.\n    function moveEpochPublishingAllocation(\n        uint72 fromId,\n        uint72 toId,\n        uint256 epoch,\n        uint96 amount\n    ) external onlyContracts {\n        nodesEpochPublishingAllocation[fromId][epoch] -= amount;\n        nodesEpochPublishingAllocation[toId][epoch] += amount; // epoch total unchanged -> K_total net-zero\n\n        if (nodesEpochPublishingAllocation[toId][epoch] > epochNodeMaxPublishingAllocation[epoch]) {\n            epochNodeMaxPublishingAllocation[epoch] = nodesEpochPublishingAllocation[toId][epoch];\n        }\n    }\n\n    function getEpochPublishingAllocation(uint256 epoch) external view returns (uint96) {\n        return epochPublishingAllocation[epoch];\n    }\n\n    function getCurrentEpochPublishingAllocation() external view returns (uint96) {\n        return epochPublishingAllocation[chronos.getCurrentEpoch()];\n    }\n\n    function getPreviousEpochPublishingAllocation() external view returns (uint96) {\n        uint256 currentEpoch = chronos.getCurrentEpoch();\n        if (currentEpoch <= 1) {\n            return 0;\n        }\n        return epochPublishingAllocation[currentEpoch - 1];\n    }\n\n    function getNodeEpochPublishingAllocation(uint72 identityId, uint256 epoch) external view returns (uint96) {\n        return nodesEpochPublishingAllocation[identityId][epoch];\n    }\n\n    function getNodeCurrentEpochPublishingAllocation(uint72 identityId) external view returns (uint96) {\n        return nodesEpochPublishingAllocation[identityId][chronos.getCurrentEpoch()];\n    }\n\n    function getNodePreviousEpochPublishingAllocation(uint72 identityId) external view returns (uint96) {\n        uint256 currentEpoch = chronos.getCurrentEpoch();\n        if (currentEpoch <= 1) {\n            return 0;\n        }\n        return nodesEpochPublishingAllocation[identityId][currentEpoch - 1];\n    }\n\n    function getEpochNodeMaxPublishingAllocation(uint256 epoch) external view returns (uint96) {\n        return epochNodeMaxPublishingAllocation[epoch];\n    }\n\n    function getCurrentEpochNodeMaxPublishingAllocation() external view returns (uint96) {\n        return epochNodeMaxPublishingAllocation[chronos.getCurrentEpoch()];\n    }\n\n    function getPreviousEpochNodeMaxPublishingAllocation() external view returns (uint96) {\n        uint256 currentEpoch = chronos.getCurrentEpoch();\n        if (currentEpoch <= 1) {\n            return 0;\n        }\n        return epochNodeMaxPublishingAllocation[currentEpoch - 1];\n    }\n\n    function getNodeEpochPublishingAllocationPercentage(\n        uint72 identityId,\n        uint256 epoch\n    ) external view returns (uint256) {\n        if (epochPublishingAllocation[epoch] == 0) {\n            return 0;\n        }\n\n        return\n            (uint256(nodesEpochPublishingAllocation[identityId][epoch]) * 1e18) / epochPublishingAllocation[epoch];\n    }\n\n    function getNodeCurrentEpochPublishingAllocationPercentage(uint72 identityId) external view returns (uint256) {\n        uint256 currentEpoch = chronos.getCurrentEpoch();\n\n        if (epochPublishingAllocation[currentEpoch] == 0) {\n            return 0;\n        }\n\n        return ((uint256(nodesEpochPublishingAllocation[identityId][currentEpoch]) * 1e18) /\n            epochPublishingAllocation[currentEpoch]);\n    }\n\n    function getNodePreviousEpochPublishingAllocationPercentage(uint72 identityId) external view returns (uint256) {\n        uint256 currentEpoch = chronos.getCurrentEpoch();\n        if (currentEpoch <= 1 || epochPublishingAllocation[currentEpoch - 1] == 0) {\n            return 0;\n        }\n        return ((uint256(nodesEpochPublishingAllocation[identityId][currentEpoch - 1]) * 1e18) /\n            epochPublishingAllocation[currentEpoch - 1]);\n    }\n\n    function addTokensToEpochRange(\n        uint256 shardId,\n        uint256 startEpoch,\n        uint256 endEpoch,\n        uint96 tokenAmount\n    ) external onlyContracts {\n        // SECURITY FIX: a credit whose startEpoch is already FINALIZED is\n        // otherwise lost forever. `_finalizeEpochsUpTo` only folds `diff` for\n        // `(lastFinalizedEpoch, currentEpoch-1]` and never revisits a finalized\n        // epoch, so `diff[startEpoch] += p` at `startEpoch <= lastFinalizedEpoch`\n        // is never folded into `cumulative` (the tokens vanish \u2014 stranded in the\n        // contract with no payable pool entry) and the paired\n        // `diff[endEpoch+1] -= p` later under-credits an unrelated future epoch.\n        //\n        // Clamp the range up to `lastFinalizedEpoch + 1` \u2014 the first epoch NOT\n        // yet folded into `cumulative`, and therefore still payable (epochs above\n        // `lastFinalizedEpoch` are read via on-the-fly simulation in\n        // `getEpochPool`). This is the minimal correction: it rescues only the\n        // credits that were genuinely lost (finalized epochs) and lands them in\n        // the CLOSEST still-creditable epoch, preserving the caller's intended\n        // attribution as much as possible \u2014 PublishingConviction deliberately\n        // attributes a closed billing window to the chain epochs it overlapped,\n        // so forcing `currentEpoch` here would misattribute/delay those rewards\n        // on an idle shard. Any stricter \"settle into the current epoch\" policy\n        // belongs at the specific caller, not in this shared primitive. Clamp,\n        // don't revert: lazy past-window settlement is an intended pattern.\n        uint256 firstOpenEpoch = lastFinalizedEpoch[shardId] + 1;\n        if (startEpoch < firstOpenEpoch) {\n            startEpoch = firstOpenEpoch;\n            if (endEpoch < startEpoch) {\n                endEpoch = startEpoch;\n            }\n        }\n\n        uint256 numEpochs = endEpoch - startEpoch + 1;\n\n        uint96 totalTokens = tokenAmount + accumulatedRemainder[shardId];\n        uint96 tokensPerEpochU = uint96(totalTokens / numEpochs);\n        uint96 remainder = uint96(totalTokens % numEpochs);\n\n        accumulatedRemainder[shardId] = remainder;\n\n        int96 tokensPerEpoch = int96(tokensPerEpochU);\n\n        diff[shardId][startEpoch] += tokensPerEpoch;\n        diff[shardId][endEpoch + 1] -= tokensPerEpoch;\n\n        uint256 currentEpoch = chronos.getCurrentEpoch();\n        if (currentEpoch > 1) {\n            _finalizeEpochsUpTo(shardId, currentEpoch - 1);\n        }\n\n        emit TokensAddedToEpochRange(shardId, startEpoch, endEpoch, tokenAmount, remainder);\n    }\n\n    function payOutEpochTokens(\n        uint256 shardId,\n        uint256 epoch,\n        uint72 identityId,\n        uint96 amount\n    ) external onlyContracts {\n        uint256 currentEpoch = chronos.getCurrentEpoch();\n        if (currentEpoch > 1) {\n            _finalizeEpochsUpTo(shardId, currentEpoch - 1);\n        }\n\n        distributed[shardId][epoch] += amount;\n        nodesPaidOut[identityId][shardId][epoch] += amount;\n\n        emit EpochTokensPaidOut(shardId, epoch, identityId, amount);\n    }\n\n    function getEpochPool(uint256 shardId, uint256 epoch) public view returns (uint96) {\n        if (epoch <= lastFinalizedEpoch[shardId]) {\n            return cumulative[shardId][epoch];\n        } else {\n            return _simulateEpochFinalization(shardId, epoch);\n        }\n    }\n\n    function getEpochRemainingPool(uint256 shardId, uint256 epoch) public view returns (uint96) {\n        if (epoch <= lastFinalizedEpoch[shardId]) {\n            return cumulative[shardId][epoch] - distributed[shardId][epoch];\n        } else {\n            return _simulateEpochFinalization(shardId, epoch) - distributed[shardId][epoch];\n        }\n    }\n\n    function getCurrentEpochPool(uint256 shardId) external view returns (uint96) {\n        return getEpochPool(shardId, chronos.getCurrentEpoch());\n    }\n\n    function getCurrentEpochRemainingPool(uint256 shardId) external view returns (uint96) {\n        return getEpochRemainingPool(shardId, chronos.getCurrentEpoch());\n    }\n\n    function getPreviousEpochPool(uint256 shardId) external view returns (uint96) {\n        uint256 currentEpoch = chronos.getCurrentEpoch();\n        if (currentEpoch <= 1) {\n            return 0;\n        }\n        return getEpochPool(shardId, currentEpoch - 1);\n    }\n\n    function getPreviousEpochRemainingPool(uint256 shardId) external view returns (uint96) {\n        uint256 currentEpoch = chronos.getCurrentEpoch();\n        if (currentEpoch <= 1) {\n            return 0;\n        }\n        return getEpochRemainingPool(shardId, currentEpoch - 1);\n    }\n\n    function getEpochRangePool(uint256 shardId, uint256 startEpoch, uint256 endEpoch) external view returns (uint96) {\n        uint256 lastFinalized = lastFinalizedEpoch[shardId];\n        uint96 totalPool = 0;\n\n        if (startEpoch <= lastFinalized) {\n            for (uint256 epoch = startEpoch; epoch <= lastFinalized && epoch <= endEpoch; epoch++) {\n                totalPool += cumulative[shardId][epoch];\n            }\n        }\n\n        uint96 simulatedCumulative = lastFinalized > 0 ? cumulative[shardId][lastFinalized] : cumulative[shardId][1];\n        for (uint256 epoch = lastFinalized + 1; epoch <= endEpoch; epoch++) {\n            int96 tmp = int96(simulatedCumulative) + diff[shardId][epoch];\n            simulatedCumulative = uint96(tmp);\n            if (epoch >= startEpoch) {\n                totalPool += simulatedCumulative;\n            }\n        }\n\n        return totalPool;\n    }\n\n    function getEpochDistributedPool(uint256 shardId, uint256 epoch) external view returns (uint96) {\n        return distributed[shardId][epoch];\n    }\n\n    function getPreviousEpochDistributedPool(uint256 shardId) external view returns (uint96) {\n        uint256 currentEpoch = chronos.getCurrentEpoch();\n        if (currentEpoch <= 1) {\n            return 0;\n        }\n        return distributed[shardId][currentEpoch - 1];\n    }\n\n    function getNodeEpochPaidOut(uint256 shardId, uint72 identityId, uint256 epoch) external view returns (uint96) {\n        return nodesPaidOut[identityId][shardId][epoch];\n    }\n\n    function getNodePreviousEpochPaidOut(uint256 shardId, uint72 identityId) external view returns (uint96) {\n        uint256 currentEpoch = chronos.getCurrentEpoch();\n        if (currentEpoch <= 1) {\n            return 0;\n        }\n        return nodesPaidOut[identityId][shardId][currentEpoch - 1];\n    }\n\n    function _finalizeEpochsUpTo(uint256 shardId, uint256 epoch) internal {\n        uint256 startEpoch = lastFinalizedEpoch[shardId] + 1;\n        for (uint256 e = startEpoch; e <= epoch; e++) {\n            int96 prev = 0;\n            if (e > 1) {\n                prev = int96(cumulative[shardId][e - 1]);\n            }\n            cumulative[shardId][e] = uint96(prev + diff[shardId][e]);\n        }\n        lastFinalizedEpoch[shardId] = epoch;\n\n        emit EpochsFinalized(shardId, startEpoch, epoch);\n    }\n\n    function _simulateEpochFinalization(uint256 shardId, uint256 epoch) internal view returns (uint96) {\n        if (epoch <= lastFinalizedEpoch[shardId]) {\n            return cumulative[shardId][epoch];\n        }\n\n        uint96 simulatedCumulative = 0;\n        if (lastFinalizedEpoch[shardId] > 0) {\n            simulatedCumulative = cumulative[shardId][lastFinalizedEpoch[shardId]];\n        }\n\n        for (uint256 e = lastFinalizedEpoch[shardId] + 1; e <= epoch; e++) {\n            int96 prev = int96(simulatedCumulative);\n            int96 result = prev + diff[shardId][e];\n            simulatedCumulative = uint96(result);\n        }\n\n        return simulatedCumulative;\n    }\n}\n","keccak256":"0x74fd4c074d1dbe46453f8ffb5ed1cf3db3ca100604d631b46f5be40860bd0835","license":"Apache-2.0"},"contracts/storage/Hub.sol":{"content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0\n\npragma solidity ^0.8.20;\n\nimport {IContractStatus} from \"../interfaces/IContractStatus.sol\";\nimport {ICustodian} from \"../interfaces/ICustodian.sol\";\nimport {IInitializable} from \"../interfaces/IInitializable.sol\";\nimport {INamed} from \"../interfaces/INamed.sol\";\nimport {IVersioned} from \"../interfaces/IVersioned.sol\";\nimport {HubLib} from \"../libraries/HubLib.sol\";\nimport {UnorderedNamedContractDynamicSet} from \"../libraries/UnorderedNamedContractDynamicSet.sol\";\nimport {Ownable} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/access/Ownable.sol\";\n\ncontract Hub is INamed, IVersioned, Ownable {\n    using UnorderedNamedContractDynamicSet for UnorderedNamedContractDynamicSet.Set;\n\n    event NewContract(string contractName, address newContractAddress);\n    event ContractChanged(string contractName, address newContractAddress);\n    event NewAssetStorage(string contractName, address newContractAddress);\n    event AssetStorageChanged(string contractName, address newContractAddress);\n    event ContractRemoved(string contractName, address contractAddress);\n    event AssetStorageRemoved(string contractName, address contractAddress);\n\n    string private constant _NAME = \"Hub\";\n    string private constant _VERSION = \"1.0.0\";\n\n    UnorderedNamedContractDynamicSet.Set internal contractSet;\n    UnorderedNamedContractDynamicSet.Set internal assetStorageSet;\n\n    constructor() Ownable(msg.sender) {}\n\n    // @dev Only transactions by HubController owner or one of the owners of the MultiSig Wallet\n    modifier onlyOwnerOrMultiSigOwner() {\n        _checkOwnerOrMultiSigOwner();\n        _;\n    }\n\n    function name() external pure virtual override returns (string memory) {\n        return _NAME;\n    }\n\n    function version() external pure virtual override returns (string memory) {\n        return _VERSION;\n    }\n\n    function setContractAddress(\n        string calldata contractName,\n        address newContractAddress\n    ) external onlyOwnerOrMultiSigOwner {\n        _setContractAddress(contractName, newContractAddress);\n    }\n\n    function setAssetStorageAddress(string calldata assetStorageName, address assetStorageAddress) external onlyOwner {\n        _setAssetStorageAddress(assetStorageName, assetStorageAddress);\n    }\n\n    function removeContractByName(string calldata contractName) external onlyOwner {\n        if (contractSet.exists(contractName)) {\n            address contractAddress = contractSet.get(contractName).addr;\n\n            contractSet.remove(contractName);\n\n            emit ContractRemoved(contractName, contractAddress);\n        }\n    }\n\n    function removeContractByAddress(address contractAddress) external onlyOwner {\n        if (contractSet.exists(contractAddress)) {\n            string memory contractName = contractSet.get(contractAddress).name;\n\n            contractSet.remove(contractAddress);\n\n            emit ContractRemoved(contractName, contractAddress);\n        }\n    }\n\n    function removeAssetStorageByName(string calldata assetStorageName) external onlyOwner {\n        if (assetStorageSet.exists(assetStorageName)) {\n            address assetStorageAddress = assetStorageSet.get(assetStorageName).addr;\n\n            assetStorageSet.remove(assetStorageName);\n\n            emit AssetStorageRemoved(assetStorageName, assetStorageAddress);\n        }\n    }\n\n    function removeAssetStorageByAddress(address assetStorageAddress) external onlyOwner {\n        if (assetStorageSet.exists(assetStorageAddress)) {\n            string memory assetStorageName = assetStorageSet.get(assetStorageAddress).name;\n\n            assetStorageSet.remove(assetStorageAddress);\n\n            emit AssetStorageRemoved(assetStorageName, assetStorageAddress);\n        }\n    }\n\n    function getContractAddress(string calldata contractName) external view returns (address) {\n        return contractSet.get(contractName).addr;\n    }\n\n    function getAssetStorageAddress(string calldata assetStorageName) external view returns (address) {\n        return assetStorageSet.get(assetStorageName).addr;\n    }\n\n    function getAllContracts() external view returns (UnorderedNamedContractDynamicSet.Contract[] memory) {\n        return contractSet.getAll();\n    }\n\n    function getAllAssetStorages() external view returns (UnorderedNamedContractDynamicSet.Contract[] memory) {\n        return assetStorageSet.getAll();\n    }\n\n    function isContract(string calldata contractName) external view returns (bool) {\n        return contractSet.exists(contractName);\n    }\n\n    function isContract(address selectedContractAddress) external view returns (bool) {\n        return contractSet.exists(selectedContractAddress);\n    }\n\n    function isAssetStorage(string calldata assetStorageName) external view returns (bool) {\n        return assetStorageSet.exists(assetStorageName);\n    }\n\n    function isAssetStorage(address assetStorageAddress) external view returns (bool) {\n        return assetStorageSet.exists(assetStorageAddress);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @dev Forwards a function call to a specified target contract.\n     * @notice This function can only be called by the contract owner or a multisig owner.\n     * @param target The address of the target contract.\n     * @param data The calldata containing the function signature and arguments for the target contract's function.\n     * @return result The return data of the target contract's function call.\n     */\n    function forwardCall(address target, bytes calldata data) public onlyOwnerOrMultiSigOwner returns (bytes memory) {\n        // Check if the target contract is registered in the Hub\n        if (!contractSet.exists(target) && !assetStorageSet.exists(target)) {\n            revert HubLib.InvalidTargetContract(target);\n        }\n\n        // Perform the function call to the target contract with the specified calldata\n        (bool success, bytes memory result) = Revert the transaction with the return data as the revert reason\n                revert(ptr, size)\n            }\n        }\n\n        return result;\n    }\n\n    function   HubLib.ForwardCallInputArgs[] calldata forwardCallsData\n    ) external onlyOwnerOrMultiSigOwner {\n        _setContracts(newContracts);\n        _setAssetStorageContracts(newAssetStorageContracts);\n        _reinitializeContracts(contractsToReinitialize);\n        _forwardCalls(forwardCallsData);\n    }\n\n    function ignore.\n                }\n            }\n\n            emit ContractChanged(contractName, newContractAddress);\n        } else {\n            contractSet.append(contractName,   }\n        }\n\n        emit NewContract(contractName, newContractAddress);\n    }\n\n    function _setContracts(HubLib.Contract[] calldata newContracts) internal {\n        for (uint256 i; i < newContracts.length; ) {\n            _setContractAddress(newContracts[i].name, newContracts[i].addr);\n\n            unchecked {\n                i++;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    function _setAssetStorageAddress(string calldata assetStorageName, address assetStorageAddress) internal {\n        if (assetStorageSet.exists(assetStorageName)) {\n            emit NewAssetStorage(assetStorageName, assetStorageAddress);\n            assetStorageSet.append(assetStorageName, assetStorageAddress);\n        }\n    }\n\n    function _setAssetStorageContracts(HubLib.Contract[] calldata newAssetStorageContracts) internal {\n        for (uint256 i; i < newAssetStorageContracts.length; ) {\n            _setAssetStorageAddress(newAssetStorageContracts[i].name, newAssetStorageContracts[i].addr);\n\n            unchecked {\n                i++;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    function _reinitializeContracts(address[] calldata contractsToReinitialize) internal {\n        for (uint256 i; i < contractsToReinitialize.length; ) {\n            IInitializable(contractsToReinitialize[i]).initialize();\n            unchecked {\n                i++;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    function _forwardCalls(HubLib.ForwardCallInputArgs[] calldata forwardCallsData) internal {\n        for (uint256 i; i < forwardCallsData.length; ) {\n            address contractAddress;\n\n            // Try to get the contract address using getContractAddress\n            try this.getContractAddress(forwardCallsData[i].contractName) returns (address addr) {\n                contractAddress = addr;\n            } catch {\n                // If getContractAddress fails, try getAssetStorageAddress\n                try this.getAssetStorageAddress(forwardCallsData[i].contractName) returns (address addr) {\n                    contractAddress = addr;\n                } catch {\n                    revert HubLib.ContractNotRegistered(forwardCallsData[i].contractName);\n                }\n            }\n            for (uint256 j; j < forwardCallsData[i].encodedData.length; ) {\n                forwardCall(contractAddress, forwardCallsData[i].encodedData[j]);\n                unchecked {\n                    j++;\n                }\n            }\n            unchecked {\n                i++;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    function _isContract(address addr) internal view returns (bool) {\n        uint256 size;\n        assembly {\n            size := extcodesize(addr)\n        }\n        return size > 0;\n    }\n\n    function _isMultiSigOwner(address multiSigAddress) internal view returns (bool) {\n        try ICustodian(multiSigAddress).getOwners() returns (address[] memory multiSigOwners) {\n            for (uint256 i = 0; i < multiSigOwners.length; i++) {\n                if (msg.sender == multiSigOwners[i]) {\n                    return true;\n                }\n            }\n        } catch {\n            // Not a multisig or call reverted; treat as not owner.\n        }\n\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    function _checkOwnerOrMultiSigOwner() internal view virtual {\n        address hubOwner = owner();\n        if (msg.sender != hubOwner && !_isMultiSigOwner(hubOwner)) {\n            revert HubLib.UnauthorizedAccess(\"Only Hub Owner or Multisig Owner\");\n        }\n    }\n}\n","keccak256":"0x732252bb857277a35ab314beef2dbaceb5f96ce2f6d3b83a224927e503609def","license":"Apache-2.0"},"contracts/storage/IdentityStorage.sol":{"content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0\n\npragma solidity ^0.8.20;\n\nimport {HubDependent} from \"../abstract/HubDependent.sol\";\nimport {IERC734Extended} from \"../interfaces/IERC734Extended.sol\";\nimport {INamed} from \"../libraries/IdentityLib.sol\";\nimport {IdentityStorage} from \"../storage/IdentityStorage.sol\";\n\ncontract IdentityStorage is IERC734Extended, INamed, IVersioned, HubDependent {\n    using ByteArr for bytes32[];\n\n    string private constant _NAME = \"IdentityStorage\";\n    string private constant _VERSION = \"10.0.2\";\n\n    uint72 public lastIdentityId;\n\n    struct Identity {\n        mapping(bytes32 => Key) keys;\n        mapping(uint256 => bytes32[]) keysByPurpose;\n    }\n\n    // operationalKey => identityId\n    mapping(bytes32 => uint72) public identityIds;\n    // identityId => Identity\n    mapping(uint72 => Identity) internal identities;\n\n    constructor(address hubAddress) HubDependent(hubAddress) {}\n\n    function name() external pure virtual override returns (string memory) {\n        return _NAME;\n    }\n\n    function version() external pure virtual override returns (string memory) {\n        return _VERSION;\n    }\n\n    function operationalKeysNumber = operationalKeys.length;\n\n        for (uint256 i; i < operationalKeysNumber; ) {\n            delete identityIds[operationalKeys[i]];\n            unchecked {\n                i++;\n            }\n        }\n\n        delete identities[identityId];\n    }\n\n    function addKey(\n        uint72 identityId,\n        bytes32 _key,\n        uint256 _purpose,\n        uint256 _type\n    ) external virtual override onlyContracts {\n        Identity storage identity = identities[identityId];\n        identity.keys[_key].purpose = _purpose;\n        identity.keys[_key].keyType = _type;\n        identity.keys[_key].key = _key;\n        identity.keysByPurpose[_purpose].push(_key);\n\n        emit KeyAdded(identityId, _key, _purpose, _type);\n    }\n\n    function removeKey(uint72 identityId, bytes32 _key) external virtual override onlyContracts {\n        IdentityStorage.Identity storage identity = identities[identityId];\n\n        uint256 index;\n        (index, ) = identity.keysByPurpose[identity.keys[_key].purpose].indexOf(_key);\n        identity.keysByPurpose[identity.keys[_key].purpose].removeByIndex(index);\n\n        emit KeyRemoved(identityId, identity.keys[_key].key, identity.keys[_key].purpose, identity.keys[_key].keyType);\n\n        delete identity.keys[_key];\n    }\n\n    function keyHasPurpose(\n        uint72 identityId,\n        bytes32 _key,\n        uint256 _purpose\n    ) external view virtual override returns (bool) {\n        return identities[identityId].keys[_key].purpose == _purpose;\n    }\n\n    function getKey(\n        uint72 identityId,\n        bytes32 _key\n    ) external view virtual override returns (uint256, uint256, bytes32) {\n        return (\n            identities[identityId].keys[_key].purpose,\n            identities[identityId].keys[_key].keyType,\n            identities[identityId].keys[_key].key\n        );\n    }\n\n    function getKeysByPurpose(\n        uint72 identityId,\n        uint256 _purpose\n    ) external view virtual override returns (bytes32[] memory) {\n        return identities[identityId].keysByPurpose[_purpose];\n    }\n\n    function getIdentityId(address operational) external view returns (uint72) {\n        return identityIds[keccak256(abi.encodePacked(operational))];\n    }\n\n    function setOperationalKeyIdentityId(bytes32 operationalKey, uint72 identityId) external virtual onlyContracts {\n        identityIds[operationalKey] = identityId;\n    }\n\n    function removeOperationalKeyIdentityId(bytes32 operationalKey) external virtual onlyContracts {\n        delete identityIds[operationalKey];\n    }\n\n    function setLastIdentityId(uint72 identityId) external virtual onlyContracts {\n        lastIdentityId = identityId;\n    }\n\n    function generateIdentityId() external virtual onlyContracts returns (uint72) {\n        unchecked {\n            return ++lastIdentityId;\n        }\n    }\n}\n","keccak256":"0xef5c32eff475aef41483352683fad4e27f33e2bb9d4a0b891cf02e1987acce91","license":"Apache-2.0"},"contracts/storage/ParametersStorage.sol":{"content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0\n\npragma solidity ^0.8.20;\n\nimport {HubDependent} from \"../abstract/HubDependent.sol\";\nimport {INamed} from \"../interfaces/INamed.sol\";\nimport {IVersioned} from \"../interfaces/IVersioned.sol\";\nimport {ICustodian} from \"../interfaces/ICustodian.sol\";\n\ncontract ParametersStorage is INamed, IVersioned, HubDependent {\n    event ParameterChanged(string parameterName, uint256 parameterValue);\n    /// @notice Emitted when the protocol treasury recipient changes. The\n    ///         address is carried in its own event (rather than the\n    ///         `uint256`-valued `ParameterChanged`) so off-chain indexers get a\n    ///         typed `address` field.\n    event ProtocolTreasurySet(address indexed treasury);\n\n    error ZeroShardingTableSizeLimit();\n\n    string private constant _NAME = \"ParametersStorage\";\n    // protocol treasury fee (`protocolTreasuryFee`, `protocolTreasury`,\n    // `MAX_PROTOCOL_TREASURY_FEE`) skimmed from the staker-bound TRAC on\n    // every paid publish / update / lifetime-extension.\n    string private constant _VERSION = \"10.0.4\";\n\n    uint96 public minimumStake;\n    uint96 public maximumStake;\n\n    uint256 public stakeWithdrawalDelay;\n    uint256 public nodeAskUpdateDelay;\n    uint256 public operatorFeeUpdateDelay;\n\n    uint16 public opWalletsLimitOnProfileCreation;\n    uint16 public shardingTableSizeLimit;\n\n    uint256 public minimumRequiredSignatures;\n\n    uint256 public askUpperBoundFactor;\n    uint256 public askLowerBoundFactor;\n\n    uint16 public maxOperatorFee;\n\n    uint256 public v81ReleaseEpoch;\n    uint256 public publishingConvictionEpochs;\n\n    /// @notice Protocol treasury fee in basis points (out of 10_000) skimmed\n    ///         from the staker-bound TRAC on every paid publish / update /\n    ///         lifetime-extension. The fee is taken out of the amount that\n    ///         would otherwise flow to the staker reward pool \u2014 it does NOT\n    ///         change the price a publisher pays. Default 300 (3%).\n    ///\n    ///         The fee is a no-op while `protocolTreasury == address(0)`\n    ///         (the full amount flows to stakers), so it stays dormant until\n    ///         governance wires a treasury recipient via `setProtocolTreasury`.\n    uint16 public protocolTreasuryFee;\n\n    /// @notice Recipient of the protocol treasury fee. The zero address\n    ///         disables the fee entirely regardless of `protocolTreasuryFee`.\n    address public protocolTreasury;\n\n    /// @notice Minimum TRAC deposit required to register a Context Graph\n    ///         on-chain (`ContextGraphs.createContextGraph`). The deposit is\n    ///         held as the CG's prepaid publishing escrow \u2014 spendable by the\n    ///         CG owner on publish/update/extend into that CG \u2014 and is never\n    ///         cash-refundable (residue sweeps to the staker reward pool on\n    ///         deactivation). Anti-spam for the unbounded-CG-creation DoS\n    ///         (OT-RFC-53). Setting it to 0 disables the deposit (dormant).\n    uint96 public contextGraphRegistrationDeposit;\n\n    /// @notice Hard upper bound on `protocolTreasuryFee` (10%). Bounds\n    ///         governance so the fee can never be set to an extractive level\n    ///         that would starve the staker reward pool.\n    uint16 public constant MAX_PROTOCOL_TREASURY_FEE = 1_000;\n\n    /// @notice Hard upper bound on `publishingConvictionEpochs`.\n    ///\n    /// `DKGPublishingConvictionNFT._settleElapsed` / `_finalSweep` loop\n    /// `lockDurationEpochs` times in the worst case (dormant account\n    /// settled at expiry). Each iteration costs ~30\u201350k gas\n    /// (`windowSpent` SLOAD + one or two `epochStorage.addTokensToEpochRange`\n    /// writes + a `WindowSettled` event), so an unbounded\n    /// `publishingConvictionEpochs` (the previous cap was `uint16.max`)\n    /// would let governance brick PCAs by setting the parameter past\n    /// the block-gas budget. 60 chain epochs \u2248 5 years at a 1-month\n    /// epoch length and worst-cases at ~3M gas \u2014 comfortably below\n    /// the block limit while leaving room for the surrounding\n    /// `publish` / `topUp` / NFT-transfer work.\n    uint256 public constant MAX_PUBLISHING_CONVICTION_EPOCHS = 60;\n\n    // @dev Only transactions by HubController owner or one of the owners of the MultiSig Wallet\n    modifier onlyOwnerOrMultiSigOwner() {\n        _checkOwnerOrMultiSigOwner();\n        _;\n    }\n\n    constructor(address hubAddress, uint256 _v81ReleaseEpoch) HubDependent(hubAddress) {\n        minimumStake = 50_000 ether;\n        maximumStake = 10_000_000 ether;\n\n        stakeWithdrawalDelay = 28 days;\n        nodeAskUpdateDelay = 1 days;\n        operatorFeeUpdateDelay = 28 days;\n\n        opWalletsLimitOnProfileCreation = 50;\n        shardingTableSizeLimit = 500;\n\n        minimumRequiredSignatures = 3;\n\n        askUpperBoundFactor = 1467000000000000000;\n        askLowerBoundFactor = 533000000000000000;\n\n        maxOperatorFee = 10_000;\n\n        // Epoch when v8.1 was released on mainnet/testnet\n        // Change if you ever redeploy delegatorsInfo contract on either network\n        v81ReleaseEpoch = _v81ReleaseEpoch;\n        publishingConvictionEpochs = 12;\n\n        // 3% default. Dormant until `protocolTreasury` is set (defaults to\n        // the zero address), so a fresh deploy behaves exactly as before\n        // until governance opts in.\n        protocolTreasuryFee = 300;\n\n        // OT-RFC-53: constructor leaves the registration deposit at 0; the\n        // standard deploy sets the live value (100 TRAC) via a post-deploy\n        // script that calls `setContextGraphRegistrationDeposit`. This protects\n        // production automatically (no manual step, no silent-off) while keeping\n        // test fixtures \u2014 which don't run that script \u2014 unaffected. Governance\n        // can retune or disable it anytime.\n    }\n\n    function name() external pure virtual override returns (string memory) {\n        return _NAME;\n    }\n\n    function version() external pure virtual override returns (string memory) {\n        return _VERSION;\n    }\n\n    function setAskUpperBoundFactor(uint256 _askUpperBoundFactor) external onlyOwnerOrMultiSigOwner {\n        askUpperBoundFactor = _askUpperBoundFactor;\n    }\n\n    function setAskLowerBoundFactor(uint256 _askLowerBoundFactor) external onlyOwnerOrMultiSigOwner {\n        askLowerBoundFactor = _askLowerBoundFactor;\n    }\n\n    function setMinimumRequiredSignatures(uint256 _minimumRequiredSignatures) external onlyOwnerOrMultiSigOwner {\n        minimumRequiredSignatures = _minimumRequiredSignatures;\n\n        emit ParameterChanged(\"minimumRequiredSignatures\", _minimumRequiredSignatures);\n    }\n\n    function setMinimumStake(uint96 newMinimumStake) external onlyOwnerOrMultiSigOwner {\n        minimumStake = newMinimumStake;\n\n        emit ParameterChanged(\"minimumStake\", newMinimumStake);\n    }\n\n    function setMaximumStake(uint96 newMaximumStake) external onlyOwnerOrMultiSigOwner {\n        maximumStake = newMaximumStake;\n\n        emit ParameterChanged(\"maximumStake\", newMaximumStake);\n    }\n\n    function setStakeWithdrawalDelay(uint256 newStakeWithdrawalDelay) external onlyOwnerOrMultiSigOwner {\n        stakeWithdrawalDelay = newStakeWithdrawalDelay;\n\n        emit ParameterChanged(\"stakeWithdrawalDelay\", newStakeWithdrawalDelay);\n    }\n\n    function setNodeAskUpdateDelay(uint256 newNodeAskUpdateDelay) external onlyOwnerOrMultiSigOwner {\n        nodeAskUpdateDelay = newNodeAskUpdateDelay;\n\n        emit ParameterChanged(\"nodeAskUpdateDelay\", newNodeAskUpdateDelay);\n    }\n\n    function setOperatorFeeUpdateDelay(uint256 newOperatorFeeUpdateDelay) external onlyOwnerOrMultiSigOwner {\n        operatorFeeUpdateDelay = newOperatorFeeUpdateDelay;\n\n        emit ParameterChanged(\"operatorFeeUpdateDelay\", newOperatorFeeUpdateDelay);\n    }\n\n    function setOpWalletsLimitOnProfileCreation(\n        uint16 opWalletsLimitOnProfileCreation_\n    ) external onlyOwnerOrMultiSigOwner {\n        opWalletsLimitOnProfileCreation = opWalletsLimitOnProfileCreation_;\n\n        emit ParameterChanged(\"opWalletsLimitOnProfileCreation\", opWalletsLimitOnProfileCreation);\n    }\n\n    function setShardingTableSizeLimit(uint16 shardingTableSizeLimit_) external onlyOwnerOrMultiSigOwner {\n        // Reject 0: ShardingTable._insertNode now enforces this cap\n        // (`nodesCount >= limit` reverts ShardingTableIsFull), so a 0 limit would\n        // freeze ALL node admission (even the first insert), bricking staking. 0\n        // is never a meaningful table size \u2014 reject it rather than let it act as\n        // an implicit pause switch.\n        if (shardingTableSizeLimit_ == 0) revert ZeroShardingTableSizeLimit();\n        shardingTableSizeLimit = shardingTableSizeLimit_;\n\n        emit ParameterChanged(\"shardingTableSizeLimit\", shardingTableSizeLimit);\n    }\n\n    function setMaxOperatorFee(uint16 maxOperatorFee_) external onlyOwnerOrMultiSigOwner {\n        maxOperatorFee = maxOperatorFee_;\n\n        emit ParameterChanged(\"maxOperatorFee\", maxOperatorFee);\n    }\n\n    function setV81ReleaseEpoch(uint256 _v81ReleaseEpoch) external onlyOwnerOrMultiSigOwner {\n        v81ReleaseEpoch = _v81ReleaseEpoch;\n\n        emit ParameterChanged(\"v81ReleaseEpoch\", _v81ReleaseEpoch);\n    }\n\n    function setPublishingConvictionEpochs(\n        uint256 _publishingConvictionEpochs\n    ) external onlyOwnerOrMultiSigOwner {\n        require(_publishingConvictionEpochs > 0, \"publishingConvictionEpochs must be > 0\");\n        // See `MAX_PUBLISHING_CONVICTION_EPOCHS` for the gas-budget\n        // rationale. The previous `<= type(uint16).max` bound permitted\n        // values that would gas-out PCA settlement.\n        require(\n            _publishingConvictionEpochs <= MAX_PUBLISHING_CONVICTION_EPOCHS,\n            \"publishingConvictionEpochs too large\"\n        );\n        publishingConvictionEpochs = _publishingConvictionEpochs;\n\n        emit ParameterChanged(\"publishingConvictionEpochs\", _publishingConvictionEpochs);\n    }\n\n    function setContextGraphRegistrationDeposit(uint96 amount) external onlyOwnerOrMultiSigOwner {\n        contextGraphRegistrationDeposit = amount;\n\n        emit ParameterChanged(\"contextGraphRegistrationDeposit\", amount);\n    }\n\n    function setProtocolTreasuryFee(uint16 protocolTreasuryFee_) external onlyOwnerOrMultiSigOwner {\n        // See `MAX_PROTOCOL_TREASURY_FEE` for the rationale on the upper\n        // bound. 0 is allowed (disables the fee while keeping the recipient\n        // wired) \u2014 the floor is enforced implicitly by the unsigned type.\n        require(protocolTreasuryFee_ <= MAX_PROTOCOL_TREASURY_FEE, \"protocolTreasuryFee too large\");\n        protocolTreasuryFee = protocolTreasuryFee_;\n\n        emit ParameterChanged(\"protocolTreasuryFee\", protocolTreasuryFee_);\n    }\n\n    function setProtocolTreasury(address protocolTreasury_) external onlyOwnerOrMultiSigOwner {\n        protocolTreasury = protocolTreasury_;\n\n        emit ProtocolTreasurySet(protocolTreasury_);\n    }\n\n    function _isMultiSigOwner(address multiSigAddress) internal view returns (bool) {\n        // First check if the address has contract code\n        uint256 size;\n        assembly {\n            size := extcodesize(multiSigAddress)\n        }\n\n        // If no contract code, it's an EOA, not a multisig\n        if (size == 0) {\n            return false;\n        }\n\n        try ICustodian(multiSigAddress).getOwners() returns (address[] memory multiSigOwners) {\n            for (uint256 i = 0; i < multiSigOwners.length; i++) {\n                if (msg.sender == multiSigOwners[i]) {\n                    return true;\n                }\n            }\n        } catch {\n            // Not a multisig or call reverted; treat as not owner.\n        }\n\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    function _checkOwnerOrMultiSigOwner() internal view virtual {\n        address hubOwner = hub.owner();\n        if (msg.sender != hubOwner && msg.sender != address(hub) && !_isMultiSigOwner(hubOwner)) {\n            revert(\"Only Hub Owner, Hub, or Multisig Owner can call\");\n        }\n    }\n}\n","keccak256":"0xcfa8ee19dacc2be0de28973802d18037bfac66537db226afc21d259611c5bac2","license":"Apache-2.0"},"contracts/storage/ProfileStorage.sol":{"content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0\n\npragma solidity ^0.8.20;\n\nimport {HubDependent} from \"../abstract/HubDependent.sol\";\nimport {ProfileLib} from \"../libraries/ProfileLib.sol\";\nimport {INamed} from \"../interfaces/INamed.sol\";\nimport {IVersioned} from \"../interfaces/IVersioned.sol\";\n\ncontract ProfileStorage is INamed, IVersioned, HubDependent {\n    string private constant _NAME = \"ProfileStorage\";\n    // Bumped 1.0.0 -> 1.1.0: ProfileInfo struct extended with relayCapable\n    // (RFC 04 v0.3 / Issue #461). New mapping reads on existing keys return\n    // false for the new field. Multiaddrs were briefly added on a prior\n    // revision but are deliberately not stored on Profile (RFC 04 \u00a75.2).\n    // 10.0.3 -> 10.0.4: active-fee getters (fee / percentage / effective-date)\n    // centralized in `_activeOperatorFee`, fixing the `operatorFees[length - 2]`\n    // underflow panic on the single-not-yet-effective-fee state (the effective-date\n    // getter still had it).\n    string private constant _VERSION = \"10.0.4\";\n\n    event ProfileCreated(uint72 indexed identityId, string nodeName, bytes nodeId, uint16 initialOperatorFee);\n    event ProfileDeleted(uint72 indexed identityId, bytes nodeId);\n    event NodeNameUpdated(uint72 indexed identityId, string oldName, string newName);\n    event NodeIdUpdated(uint72 indexed identityId, bytes oldNodeId, bytes newNodeId);\n    event NodeAskUpdated(uint72 indexed identityId, uint96 oldAsk, uint96 newAsk);\n    event OperatorFeeAdded(uint72 indexed identityId, uint16 feePercentage, uint256 effectiveDate);\n    event OperatorFeesReplaced(\n        uint72 indexed identityId,\n        uint16 oldFeePercentage,\n        uint16 newFeePercentage,\n        uint256 effectiveDate\n    );\n    event OperatorFeesUpdated(uint72 indexed identityId, ProfileLib.OperatorFee[] operatorFees);\n    // RFC 04 v0.3: relay-capability flag (multiaddrs live in attestation KAs, not Profile).\n    event RelayCapabilityUpdated(uint72 indexed identityId, bool oldValue, bool newValue);\n\n    mapping(uint72 => ProfileLib.ProfileInfo) public profiles;\n    mapping(string => bool) public isNameTaken;\n    mapping(bytes => bool) public nodeIdsList;\n    mapping(uint72 => uint256) public askUpdateCooldown;\n\n    constructor(address hubAddress) HubDependent(hubAddress) {}\n\n    function name() external pure override returns (string memory) {\n        return _NAME;\n    }\n\n    function version() external pure override returns (string memory) {\n        return _VERSION;\n    }\n\n    function createProfile(\n        uint72 identityId,\n        string calldata nodeName,\n        bytes calldata nodeId,\n        uint16 initialOperatorFee\n    ) external onlyContracts {\n        ProfileLib.ProfileInfo storage profile = profiles[identityId];\n        profile.name = nodeName;\n        profile.nodeId = nodeId;\n        profile.operatorFees.push(ProfileLib.OperatorFee(initialOperatorFee, block.timestamp));\n        nodeIdsList[nodeId] = true;\n\n        emit ProfileCreated(identityId, nodeName, nodeId, initialOperatorFee);\n    }\n\n    function getProfile(\n        uint72 identityId\n    )\n        external\n        view\n        returns (\n            string memory,\n            bytes memory,\n            uint96,\n            ProfileLib.OperatorFee[] memory,\n            bool\n        )\n    {\n        ProfileLib.ProfileInfo storage profile = profiles[identityId];\n\n        return (\n            profile.name,\n            profile.nodeId,\n            profile.ask,\n            profile.operatorFees,\n            profile.relayCapable\n        );\n    }\n\n    function deleteProfile(uint72 identityId) external onlyContracts {\n        bytes memory nodeId = profiles[identityId].nodeId;\n        nodeIdsList[nodeId] = false;\n        delete profiles[identityId];\n\n        emit ProfileDeleted(identityId, nodeId);\n    }\n\n    function getName(uint72 identityId) external view returns (string memory) {\n        return profiles[identityId].name;\n    }\n\n    function setName(uint72 identityId, string memory _name) external onlyContracts {\n        ProfileLib.ProfileInfo storage profile = profiles[identityId];\n        string memory oldName = profile.name;\n\n        profile.name = _name;\n\n        emit NodeNameUpdated(identityId, oldName, _name);\n    }\n\n    function getNodeId(uint72 identityId) external view returns (bytes memory) {\n        return profiles[identityId].nodeId;\n    }\n\n    function setNodeId(uint72 identityId, bytes calldata nodeId) external onlyContracts {\n        ProfileLib.ProfileInfo storage profile = profiles[identityId];\n        bytes memory oldNodeId = profile.nodeId;\n\n        nodeIdsList[oldNodeId] = false;\n        profile.nodeId = nodeId;\n        nodeIdsList[nodeId] = true;\n\n        emit NodeIdUpdated(identityId, oldNodeId, nodeId);\n    }\n\n    function setAsk(uint72 identityId, uint96 ask) external onlyContracts {\n        ProfileLib.ProfileInfo storage profile = profiles[identityId];\n        uint96 oldAsk = profile.ask;\n\n        profile.ask = ask;\n\n        emit NodeAskUpdated(identityId, oldAsk, ask);\n    }\n\n    function setAskUpdateCooldown(uint72 identityId, uint256 cooldownEnd) external onlyContracts {\n        askUpdateCooldown[identityId] = cooldownEnd;\n    }\n\n    function getAsk(uint72 identityId) external view returns (uint96) {\n nodeEpochIndex[identityId][epoch];\n        uint256 n = ei.mid.length;\n        // M6 \u2014 no first-sentinel anymore; absent checkpoint \u2192 0 (natural\n        //      pre-any-proof default under D26's epoch-local accumulator).\n        if (n == 0) {\n            return 0;\n        }\n        // Largest i with mid[i].timestamp <= ts via binary search.\n        uint256 lo = 0;\n        uint256 hi = n;\n        while (lo < hi) {\n            uint256 mid = (lo + hi) >> 1;\n            if (ei.mid[mid].timestamp <= ts) {\n                lo = mid + 1;\n            } else {\n                hi = mid;\n            }\n        }\n        if (lo == 0) {\n            return 0;\n        }\n        return ei.mid[lo - 1].scorePerStake36;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @dev Returns the last settled score 10^36\n     */\n    function getDelegatorLastSettledNodeEpochScorePerStake(\n        uint256 epoch,\n        uint72 identityId,\n        bytes32 delegatorKey\n    ) external view returns (uint256) {\n SafeERC20FailedOperation(address).details: An operation with an ERC-20 token failed.

claim(address,uint256).details: D6 — retroactive claim for migrated positions. If      `pos.migrationEpoch != 0` AND `pos.migrationEpoch > pos.lastClaimedEpoch + 1`,      the claim window starts from `pos.migrationEpoch` instead of      `pos.lastClaimedEpoch + 1`. For a fresh V8→V10 migration where      the user never claimed pre-migration, this collapses to "start      the claim at the migration epoch". For a later-life migration      (shouldn't happen in the mandatory-migration model but kept      behavior-defined), the `max(lastClaimedEpoch+1, migrationEpoch)`      semantics prevent double-claiming.      D19 — reward handling:        1. Sum per-epoch rewards across the window (V10 math —           CSS per-epoch operator fee + net-node rewards).        2. `cs.increaseRaw(tokenId, rewardTotal)` — raw grows; the           compounded TRAC earns the position's current multiplier           going forward; per-epoch effective-stake diff updated.        3. `cs.addCumulativeRewardsClaimed(tokenId, rewardTotal)` —           statistic-only lifetime counter.        4. `cs.setLastClaimedEpoch(tokenId, toEpoch)` — advance cursor.      No StakingStorage writes.

drainOperatorFeeToCredit(uint72,address).details: "one credit": the operator fee folds         into the SAME `migrationCredit` bucket as delegator stake, so         the operator recovers it exactly like a delegator — `allocate`         at tier 0 (immediately withdrawable) or 6/12 (conviction).         Operator addresses are NOT recoverable on-chain — IdentityStorage         holds key *hashes*, not addresses — so the off-chain sweep         supplies `operator` and this function validates it currently         holds ADMIN_KEY on the node (mirroring who V8         `finalizeOperatorFeeWithdrawal` would have paid). A stale/wrong         address REVERTS rather than crediting silently, so a         mis-resolved operator can never be paid; the sweep hard-fails         and re-resolves. The check is skipped only when there is nothing         to drain (`total == 0`), keeping re-runs idempotent and cheap.

drainV8ToCredit(address,uint72).details: no per-source eligibility: the full drained amount is         credited to the delegator; the tier-6/12 lock-credit is decided         later in `allocateFromCredit` from the chosen tier.

initialize().details: Wires Hub-registered dependencies. DelegatorsInfo and the V8      `Staking` contract are NOT looked up here (D3 + D17 + D13):      DelegatorsInfo is unregistered by deploy script 021, V8 Staking      is unregistered by deploy script 998 as part of the migration      cutover.

redelegate(address,uint256,uint72).details: D25 — in-place redelegate. The tokenId, `expiryEpoch`,      `lockTier`, `multiplier18`, `lastClaimedEpoch`, `migrationEpoch`      and `cumulativeRewardsClaimed` are ALL preserved. The lock      clock does NOT reset: a redelegation is a routing decision,      not a new commitment. CSS's `updateOnRedelegate` moves the      per-node effective-stake contribution at `currentEpoch` and      reassigns the pending expiry drop from the old node to the      new node at the same `expiryEpoch`.      Fresh stakes still gate on the destination's `maxStake` —      redelegating INTO a near-capped node can still revert. The      min-stake boundary on the OLD node may trigger a sharding-      table removal; the new node may cross back in. Ask recalc      runs once at the end.

relock(address,uint256,uint256,uint40).details: Continuity preserved across the burn-mint:        - `raw` (principal unchanged — no TRAC moves).        - `cumulativeRewardsClaimed` (lifetime reward stat).        - `lastClaimedEpoch` (reward cursor — prevents double-claim).        - `migrationEpoch` (D6 retroactive-claim marker).      Re-initialized on the new tokenId:        - `lockTier`, `multiplier18`, `expiryEpoch` (the whole point          of relock).      `identityId` is held constant — this is relock, not redelegate.

setV10LaunchEpoch(uint256).details: D7 — the V10 launch epoch is the cutoff past which V8-era      state should not continue to accrue rewards; anything the      migration process hasn't swept by this epoch is treated as a      straggler and drained via `adminDrainBatch` / `adminMigrateToCredit`.

stake(address,uint256,uint72,uint96,uint.details: V10 flow (D15 — CSS-only accounting):        1. Amount + tier validation.        2. Destination profile existence.        3. maxStake cap on the DESTINATION V10 node stake           (`cs.nodeStakeV10`, NOT `ss.nodeStake`). StakingStorage's           node stake is V8 legacy and stale post-migration.        4. V10 settlement baseline (zero stake, bumps the           node-epoch-score-per-stake cursor for this token).        5. TRAC transfer into the StakingStorage vault (still the           protocol-wide TRAC custody).        6. CSS position creation (migrationEpoch = 0 — fresh stake).        7. Sharding-table insert threshold, Ask recalc.

withdraw(address,uint256).details: D14 — atomic withdraw. No request / cancel / finalize dance,      no address-timer delay: the lock IS the delay. Partial      withdrawals are NOT a first-class feature — a user wanting      partial liquidity should withdraw the whole position and      re-stake the remainder, which gives the same economic      result (tier-0 with 1x multiplier is effectively liquid      stake). Q3 — rewards are auto-claimed inside this call so      the user sees a single button in the UI.

NodeAdmissionDeferred(uint72,uint256).notice: Emitted when a node crosses `minimumStake` during a stake / redelegate / claim but the sharding table is full, so its admission is deferred. Admission is best-effort housekeeping: the node stays out of the ring (earning no score, which is correct) and is re-attempted on the next stake/claim once a slot frees. The caller's stake / claim / withdraw / redelegate is never blocked by a full table. #1286

Withdrawn(uint256,address,uint96).notice: Authoritative atomic-withdraw event. `amount` is the total         TRAC paid out to `staker` (post-auto-claim `raw`). The NFT         wrapper burns `tokenId` on the back half.

admitNode(uint72).notice: Permissionless maintenance: admit a node that is eligible for the sharding table (V10 stake >= `minimumStake`) but not currently in it — e.g. one whose opportunistic admission was deferred because the table was full (`_tryAdmitNode` / #1286). Anyone may bring an eligible node into the ring once a slot frees, without the node's staker needing to add stake or trigger a reward claim (a zero-reward `_claim` returns before its inline admission). Reverts `ShardingTableIsFull` if the table is still full (so the caller learns), or `NodeAlreadyInShardingTable` / `NodeBelowMinimumStake` if the node is not eligible.

allocateFromCredit(address,uint256,uint7.notice: Spend `amount` of `staker`'s migration credit into a fresh V10         conviction position on `targetNode` at `lockTier`. Runs the full         stake tail (score-cursor baseline → createPosition → sharding         insert → ask recalc). Any tier-6/12 allocation applies the         `convictionCreditSeconds` lock-shortening (universal). The         wrapper supplies `tokenId` and mints after.

cancelOperatorFeeWithdrawal(uint72).notice: Cancel a pending operator-fee withdrawal and return the queued         amount to the operator-fee balance. No cooldown applies.

claim(address,uint256).notice: Walk unclaimed epochs, accumulate reward, and compound it into         the position's `raw` (D19). `cumulativeRewardsClaimed` tracks         lifetime compounding as a statistic.

claimFor(uint256).notice: Permissionless settlement: ANY caller may trigger a claim for         `tokenId`. Rewards compound into the tokenId-keyed position, so         the current NFT owner benefits regardless of caller — no funds         are routed to `msg.sender`. This is the wrapper-independent         permissionless-claim entry point: keepers can settle rewards (and         the per-epoch operator fee) without touching the stateful ERC-721         wrapper. `_claim` reverts `PositionNotFound` for a nonexistent or         already-withdrawn position, so no extra guard is required.

drainOperatorFeeToCredit(uint72,address).notice: Drain node `identityId`'s V8 operator fee (the resting         `operatorFeeBalance` PLUS any open fee-withdrawal request) into         `operator`'s migration credit on CSS. Returns the drained         `total`; a node with no fee contributes 0 (no revert here), so         the wrapper can sweep in bulk.

drainV8ToCredit(address,uint72).notice: Drain ALL of `delegator`'s V8 stake on `identityId` (active         stakeBase + any pending withdrawal, D8) into their migration         credit on CSS. Returns the drained `total` so the wrapper can         aggregate across nodes and revert if the grand total is zero;         a node with no V8 stake contributes 0 (no revert here).

finalizeOperatorFeeWithdrawal(uint72).notice: Complete an operator-fee withdrawal after the cooldown has         elapsed. Pays out from the CSS TRAC vault.

identityStorage().notice: IdentityStorage for `onlyAdmin(identityId)` admin-key checks         (operator-fee withdrawal request / finalize / cancel).

redelegate(address,uint256,uint72).notice: Move a position from its current node to `newIdentityId`.         Same tokenId persists; only `pos.identityId` mutates.         Per-node raw / effective stake moves across at `currentEpoch`;         global totals invariant.

relock(address,uint256,uint256,uint40).notice: Post-expiry re-commit of an existing position to a new lock         tier. Raw stake unchanged; multiplier + expiry shift. Under         D21 this is a burn-and-mint: `oldTokenId` is burned by the         NFT wrapper, `newTokenId` is a freshly-minted NFT the wrapper         has already allocated, and the on-chain position state moves         over via the D23 `createNewPositionFromExisting` primitive.

requestOperatorFeeWithdrawal(uint72,uint.notice: Initiate an operator-fee withdrawal. Caller must hold ADMIN_KEY         on `identityId`. Subsequent calls before finalize/cancel         augment the existing request (combined amount = old + new).

setConvictionCreditSeconds(uint40).notice: Set the V8→V10 conviction lock-credit (seconds) on CSS. Driven         by the owner-gated `setConvictionCreditSeconds` entrypoint on the         NFT wrapper (no freeze gate; settable any time pre-sweep).

setV10LaunchEpoch(uint256).notice: Admin: set the V10 launch epoch marker on CSS. This is the         retroactive-attribution boundary used by the admin migration         bookkeeping and off-chain analytics. Expected to be called         exactly once, in the deploy-script migration cutover. Gate         enforced at the NFT wrapper (`onlyOwnerOrMultiSigOwner`).

stake(address,uint256,uint72,uint96,uint.notice: Mint a fresh NFT-backed staking position on `identityId` with         `amount` TRAC locked for `lockTier` epochs.

stakingStorage().notice: V8 archive accessor — present ONLY for `_convertToNFT`'s V8→V10         drain. The V10 hot path (stake/withdraw/claim/operator-fee         accrual + withdrawal) reads and writes `convictionStorage`         exclusively (v4.0.0 consolidation).

withdraw(address,uint256).notice: Atomic full withdrawal. Post-expiry (or tier-0 rest state)         only. Auto-claims any outstanding rewards into `raw`, pays         out the full `raw` balance from the `StakingStorage` TRAC         vault to `staker`, and deletes the CSS position. The NFT         wrapper burns the token on return.

userdoc.notice: V10 NFT-backed staking orchestrator. Canonical staking entry point         post-migration. V10 architecture (post-consolidation, v3.0.0 / CSS v4.0.0):   - All V10 delegator state, the TRAC vault, AND operator-fee accounting     live in `ConvictionStakingStorage` (CSS). CSS extends `Guardian`, holds     `tokenContract`, and exposes `transferStake` for outflows. Deposits     route TRAC into the CSS address; withdrawals call `cs.transferStake`.   - `StakingStorage` is dead weight in the V10 hot path. It is read ONLY     by `_convertToNFT` (V8→V10 drain at cutover). Operator-fee balances,     operator-fee withdrawal requests, and the TRAC vault role moved into     CSS in v4.0.0.   - DelegatorsInfo is unregistered (D13). The two per-node-per-epoch     flags it used to hold (`isOperatorFeeClaimedForEpoch`,     `netNodeEpochRewards`) were absorbed into ConvictionStakingStorage.   - The V8 Staking contract is unregistered. The V8-side score     settlement helper (`Staking.prepareForStakeChange`) is no longer     reachable from V10 (D17); the V10-native `_prepareForStakeChangeV10`     handles all V10 settlement. Operator-fee request/finalize/cancel     was V8-only — v3.0.0 ports it to V10 (CSS-backed) so post-consolidation     deploys can fully drain operator fees without the V8 contract. Rewards model (D19 — compound into raw):   - `claim()` walks the unclaimed window, sums TRAC rewards, and compounds     them directly into the position's `raw` via `cs.increaseRaw`. The     compounded TRAC therefore earns the position's current multiplier     going forward. A parallel statistic-only counter     `cs.cumulativeRewardsClaimed` tracks lifetime reward compounding for     UI/indexer consumption.   - There is no separate `rewards` bucket, no `increaseRewards` /     `decreaseRewards`. Withdraw model (D14 — atomic):   - `withdraw()` is a single transaction. Pre-expiry is disallowed (lock     still active). Post-expiry (or tier-0 rest state) it auto-claims any     outstanding rewards into `raw`, pays out the full `raw` balance from     the `StakingStorage` TRAC vault to the owner, and deletes the CSS     position. The NFT wrapper burns the token on the back half. There is     no request/cancel/finalize dance and no address-timer delay — the     lock IS the delay, and partial withdrawals are not a first-class     feature (re-stake the remainder for the same economic result). Redelegate model (D25 — in-place):   - `redelegate()` is a single transaction that mutates `pos.identityId`     in place on CSS via `updateOnRedelegate`. Same tokenId, same     `expiryEpoch`, same rewards cursor — only the node assignment     changes. `relock` continues to use the D21/D23 burn-and-mint path     because relock materially changes tier / multiplier / expiry.
